thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以天人体结构、数字、性质的系统对应，论证天人相通。人身三百六十节偶天之数，形体骨肉偶地之厚，耳目聪明象日月，空窍理脉象川谷，哀乐喜怒象神气。核心原理：可数者副数，不可数者副类。天与人之间存在结构同构与功能共振，故天能谴告人、人能感应天。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Systematic correspondence between heavenly and human structures, numbers, and qualities proves heaven-human connectivity. Core principle: what can be numbered corresponds to number, what cannot be numbered corresponds to category. Heaven and human share structural isomorphism and functional resonance.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·人副天数》：人有三百六十节，偶天之数也；形体骨肉，偶地之厚也；上有耳目聪明，日月之象也；体有空窍理脉，川谷之象也；心有哀乐喜怒，神气之类也。
process_zh: 结构同构

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳二气的属性（阳主生、阴主杀；阳尊、阴卑；阳德、阴刑）为分类框架，将一切自然现象、社会关系、政治制度纳入阴阳二元结构。君为阳臣为阴、父为阳子为阴、夫为阳妻为阴——通过阴阳的尊卑主次关系论证社会等级的天然合理性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using yin-yang qi attributes (yang generates, yin kills; yang honorable, yin base; yang virtue, yin punishment) as a classification framework, all natural phenomena, social relations, and political institutions are mapped onto a yin-yang binary structure. Establishes social hierarchy as natural through yin-yang honor/base relationships.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·基义》：君臣、父子、夫妇之义，皆取诸阴阳之道。君为阳，臣为阴，父为阳，子为阴，夫为阳，妻为阴。《阴阳义》：天道之常，一阴一阳；阳者天之德也，阴者天之刑也。

modern_applications_zh: 政治哲学中的自然法论证。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 同类事物之间自动产生感应和共振。美事召美类，恶事召恶类，类之相应而起也。声同则相应，气同则会，物固类合。此法是天人感应的运作机制解释——天与人同属一类（皆有阴阳之气），故能相互感应。政治善恶亦感召相应类型的天象变化。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Things of the same category automatically resonate and influence each other. Beautiful affairs summon beautiful categories, evil affairs summon evil categories. Same sounds correspond, same qi converges. This is the operational mechanism of heaven-human resonance.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·同类相动》：美事召美类，恶事召恶类，类之相应而起也。如钟然，叩之以小者则小鸣，叩之以大者则大鸣。气同则会，声比则应。
process_zh: 同类假设

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 构建屈民而伸君，屈君而伸天的双向制衡架构。民为根本，故屈民而伸君（集中权力以安民）；君权来自天命，故屈君而伸天（以天道制约君权）。天通过灾异谴告君，君通过德政安民。形成民→君→天→民的循环制约链，既防止君权滥用，又维护政治统一。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Constructs a dual-check architecture: subordinate the people to elevate the ruler, subordinate the ruler to elevate Heaven. The people are fundamental, so power is concentrated in the ruler to protect them; the ruler's power comes from Heaven, so Heaven constrains the ruler. Creates a cyclic check: people→ruler→Heaven→people.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露》：屈民而伸君，屈君而伸天，春秋之大义也。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳四时为模型论证德治与刑罚的主次关系。阳为德、阴为刑；阳主生、阴主杀；春夏行德、秋冬行刑。阳为岁之主，阴为岁之辅——德为主、刑为辅是天道的必然要求。刑罚不是废除，而是辅助德教的手段。强调教，政之本也，主张以礼乐教化移风易俗。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using yin-yang and four seasons as model to establish virtue-punishment hierarchy. Yang is virtue, yin is punishment; spring/summer for virtue, autumn/winter for punishment. Yang is the master of the year, yin the assistant. Punishment is not abolished but serves as virtue's support. Education is the root of governance.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·阳尊阴卑》：阳者天之德也，阴者天之刑也。《天辩在人》：刑者德之辅，阴者阳之助，阳者岁之主也。《精华》：教，政之本也。

thinking_modes.name_en: Three-Tier Human Nature and Education Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人性分为三等：圣人之性（不教而善）、斗筲之性（教而不善）、中民之性（待教而善）。性中有情，性善情恶如同天有阴阳。中民之性占绝大多数，是教化的主要对象。教化是王之善事，通过太学教育和选官制度实现。性三品论为教化必要性提供理论基础，也为察举制度（举孝廉）提供依据。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature divided into three tiers: sages (naturally good), worthless (incorrigible), and the middling majority (requires education). Nature has emotion just as heaven has yin-yang. Education is the king's paramount task. Three-tier theory grounds the necessity of moral education and the merit-based selection system.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·实性》：善之名只在田者也，非以从天之质。性者，天质之朴也；善者，王教之化也。
process_zh: 本性分析

modern_applications_zh: 发展心理学的关键期理论

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 大一统是天经地义的天地之常经，古今之通谊。当时思想混乱师异道，人异论，百家殊方，导致上无以持一统，下不知所守。解决方案：凡不在六艺之科、孔子之术者，皆绝其道勿使并进。以思想统一支撑政治统一，以儒家经典作为唯一合法知识来源。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Great unity is the eternal principle of heaven and earth. Diverse schools cause confusion and undermine political unity. Solution: eliminate all non-Confucian paths. Ideological unity supports political unity; Confucian classics become the sole legitimate knowledge source.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《汉书·董仲舒传》：《春秋》大一统者，天地之常经，古今之通谊也。今师异道，人异论，百家殊方，指意不同，是以上亡以持一统，法制数变，下不知所守。臣愚以为诸不在六艺之科、孔子之术者，皆绝其道，勿使并进。
process_zh: 问题诊断（思想分裂）→ 原则确立（大一统为天经）→ 方案设计（独尊儒术）→ 预期效果（民知所从）
process_en: 问题诊断（思想分裂）→ 原则确立（大一统为天经）→ 方案设计（独尊儒术）→ 预期效果（民知所从）
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 《春秋》大一统者，天地之常经，古今之通谊也。今师异道，人异论，百家殊方，指意不同，是以上亡以持一统，法制数变，下不知所守。臣愚以为诸不在六艺之科、孔子之术者，皆绝其道，勿使并进。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天通过自然灾害和异常现象（火灾、水灾、日蚀、彗星等）对失道之君发出警告。灾先异后、灾轻异重——小的过失先以异常现象警示，不改则降灾害，再不改则亡国。这是屈君而伸天的具体运作机制，为制约皇权提供了超自然的威慑力量。补救之道在于修德省刑、施仁政。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Heaven warns rulers through natural disasters and anomalies (fires, floods, eclipses, comets). Disasters escalate from minor anomalies to national collapse. This is the operational mechanism of subordinating the ruler to Heaven, providing supernatural deterrence against arbitrary power. Remedy: cultivate virtue, reduce punishment, practice benevolence.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·必仁且智》：灾者天之谴也，异者天之威也。谴之而不知，乃畏之以威。《汉书·董仲舒传》：凡灾异之本，尽生于国家之失。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 受阴阳家五德终始影响，董仲舒提出三统三正说论证历史发展规律。夏为人统（建寅，正月岁首，尚黑），商为地统（建丑，十二月岁首，尚白），周为天统（建子，十一月岁首，尚赤）。三统循环往复，新王必改制（改正朔、易服色）以表明受命于天。改制不易道——形式可变，根本原则不变。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Drawing on yin-yang Five Phases theory, Dong proposes the Three Unities cycle. Xia is Human Unity (1st month new year, black), Shang is Earth Unity (12th month, white), Zhou is Heaven Unity (11th month, red). Cycles perpetually; new kings must reform rituals to show Mandate of Heaven. Form changes but core principles remain constant.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·三代改制质文》：新王必改制。改制之名，易姓而王，致太平必再受命。
process_zh: 周期循环

合法性传递
process_en: 周期循环

modern_applications_zh: 改革合法性的叙事构建。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 义利之辨的核心命题：正其谊不谋其利，明其道不计其功。义是对自我的要求，利是对他者的给予。仁指向他人（爱人），义指向自我（正己）。君子终日言不及利，以利为盗之本。但董仲舒并非绝对排斥功利——他承认利养体、义养心，心贵于体，故义重于利。这是价值排序而非价值否定。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The core proposition of righteousness-utility debate: Rectify righteousness without seeking profit, illuminate the Way without calculating merit. Righteousness is self-demand, benevolence is other-directed. Profit is the root of theft. But Dong does not absolutely reject utility—he acknowledges profit nourishes the body, righteousness nourishes the heart, and the heart is superior to the body.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《汉书·董仲舒传》：正其谊不谋其利，明其道不计其功。《春秋繁露·天道施》：利者，盗之本也。《玉英》：君子终日言不及利。
process_zh: 价值区分

行为准则

process_en: 价值区分

primary_domain: 王充（27-约100年），字仲任，东汉思想家、哲学家，《论衡》作者，中国历史上最早的系统性怀疑论者和
school: 自然主义者。出身贫寒，自撰《论衡》八十五篇，以'疾虚妄'为核
description_zh: 王充（27-约100年），字仲任，东汉思想家、哲学家，《论衡》作者，中国历史上最早的系统性怀疑论者和自然主义者。出身贫寒，自撰《论衡》八十五篇，以'疾虚妄'为核心方法论，对当时流行的谶纬神学、天人感应、鬼神迷信等进行全面批判。首次系统提出雷电自然成因说、水循环说，并在中国思想史上首次系统论证了气的自然主义本体论。其'问难'方法论开创了中国批判性思维传统，比欧洲文艺复兴时期的怀疑论早约一千五百年。
description_en: Wang Chong (27-c.100 CE), courtesy name Zhongren, Eastern Han thinker and philosopher, author of 'Lunheng' (Discourses Weighed in the Balance), China's earliest systematic skeptic and naturalist. Born into poverty, he wrote 85 chapters of Lunheng with the core methodology of 'attacking falsehoods', conducting comprehensive criticism of popular Chenwei theocracy, Heaven-human resonance theory, and ghost superstition. First systematically proposed natural causes of thunder/lightning and water cycle theory, and established qi-based naturalist ontology in Chinese philosophy. His 'questioning and challenging' (wen-nan) methodology pioneered Chinese critical thinking tradition, predating European Renaissance skepticism by approximately 1,500 years.
reason_zh: 核心思维：王充在中国哲学史上独树一帜，他将怀疑精神与实证方法系统结合，构建了完整的中世纪怀疑论体系。其'疾虚妄'方法论不仅批判了当时主流的谶纬神学，更开创了以经验和逻辑检验一切主张的思维范式。作为自学者，他没有学派传承，却以独立批判精神成为汉代思想的异数。其雷电说、水循环说展示了将自然现象还原为物质过程的思维方式，其鬼神批判则建立在对常识经验的严格运用之上。这种以理性批判为核心的思维，使王充成为中国古代思想史中罕见的'科学精神'先驱。
reason_en: Core thinking: Wang Chong stands alone in Chinese philosophical history, systematically combining skeptical spirit with empirical methods to construct a complete medieval skeptical system. His 'attacking falsehoods' methodology not only criticized mainstream Chenwei theocracy of the time, but also pioneered a thinking paradigm of testing all claims through experience and logic. As a self-taught scholar without school lineage, he became an outlier of Han dynasty thought through independent critical spirit. His thunder theory and water cycle theory demonstrated thinking that reduced natural phenomena to material processes; his ghost criticism established rigorous application of common-sense experience. This rationality-centered thinking makes Wang Chong a rare 'scientific spirit' pioneer in ancient Chinese intellectual history.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以批判虚妄、追求真实为核心使命，对所有未经检验的主张保持系统性怀疑态度。'疾虚妄'不仅是方法论，更是认识论立场。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking criticism of falsehood and pursuit of truth as the core mission, maintaining skeptical attitude toward all unexamined claims. 'Disease of falsehood' is not just methodology but epistemological stance.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 疾虚妄，务实诚。（《论衡·佚文》）凡论事者，决其信否，案验其事，乃能得之。（《论衡·证明》）
operation_steps: 识别需要检验的主张或信念
质疑该主张的前提假设是否成立
寻找反例或矛盾之处
用经验和逻辑检验主张的可靠性

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过不断提问和挑战来检验命题的真伪，要求每一个主张都要有明确的机制解释。问难不是为质疑而质疑，而是为了逼近真实。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Testing propositions through continuous questioning and challenging, requiring each claim to have clear mechanistic explanation. Questioning is not for its own sake but to approach truth.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 问孔刺孟，以悖论破权威。（《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》）世儒学者，好信师而是古，专精讲习，不知难问。（《论衡·问孔》）
operation_steps: 对既定命题提出定义性问题
追问机制解释（如何运作，原因是什么）
寻找逻辑矛盾或反例
通过归谬法揭示命题荒谬之处

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将天道理解为人格化的自然过程而非有意志的干预者。天没有目的，不赏善罚恶，只是气之自然运行。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Understanding Heaven as impersonal natural process rather than intentional intervenor. Heaven has no purpose, does not reward virtue or punish evil, merely qi's natural operation.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 天地合气，万物自生。（《论衡·自然》）夫天者，体也，与地同。（《论衡·祀义》）
operation_steps: 识别将自然现象人格化/目的化的倾向
追问该现象是否有实际的功能性或目的性
还原为物质过程的自然解释
拒绝任何无法验证的神圣意图假设

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 主张必须有可检验的证据支持，不接受仅凭权威或传统的论断。'凡论事者，决其信否，案验其事'是效验法的核心原则。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Claims must have verifiable evidence support; no argument accepted solely on authority or tradition. 'When discussing matters, judge their credibility, investigate and verify the facts' is the core principle.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 须任耳目以定情实。（《论衡·实知》）凡论事者，决其信否，案验其事，乃能得之。（《论衡·证明》）
operation_steps: 将待检验的主张表述为可观测的命题
设计检验方案观察现象是否符合预期
收集实际证据而非依赖传闻
用实际结果判定主张的真伪

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过推导主张的逻辑后果来揭示其矛盾或荒谬。若承认某主张，则需接受一系列不合理结论，故该主张必误。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Revealing contradiction or absurdity by deriving logical consequences of a claim. If accepting the claim leads to unreasonable conclusions, the claim must be wrong.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 引物连类，征验是非。（《论衡·案书》）道虚则仙妄，妄则无征。（《论衡·道虚》）
operation_steps: 暂时接受对方的前提或主张
按逻辑推导出该主张的所有后果
指出其中荒谬或不可接受的结论
据此否定原主张

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以气为本体解释一切现象，气的聚散构成万物的生成变化，无需借助任何超自然力量或目的因。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Explaining all phenomena through qi as substance; qi's condensation and dispersion constitute generation and change of all things, without needing any supernatural force or final cause.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 天地，含气之自然也。（《论衡·谈天》）人之生死，由气之聚散。（《论衡·论死》）
operation_steps: 将所有现象还原为物质的气和形
解释为气的聚散、升降、感应过程
拒绝引入超自然实体或目的论解释
保持解释的内在一致性和简洁性

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 用日常经验和常识作为检验理论的标准，反对将复杂化、神秘化的解释强加于简单自然现象之上。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using everyday experience and common sense as standard to test theories; opposing complex and mystified explanations forced onto simple natural phenomena.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 常人皆知，众人共见。（《论衡·说日》）须任耳目以定情实。（《论衡·实知》）
operation_steps: 将抽象命题还原为日常经验可检验的形式
检查命题是否与普遍常识和经验相符
用普通人能理解的例证说明问题
拒绝超出常识范围的过度解释

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 对经典文本持批判性态度，区分真孔孟之言与后人伪托，真理不因来自权威而成立。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Approaching canonical texts with critical attitude, distinguishing authentic from later forgery or misattribution. Truth does not hold because it comes from authority.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 问孔刺孟，以悖论破权威。（《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》）经艺出自圣人之手，然圣人不能生知。（《论衡·实知》）
operation_steps: 将文本主张与可验证的事实对照
识别文本内部的矛盾和不一致
区分原始主张与后世附会
以事实而非权威裁定文本真伪

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 用物质性的因果关系取代目的论和感应论解释，要求每个现象都有清晰的原因链条。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Replacing teleological and resonance-based explanations with material causality, requiring each phenomenon to have clear material causal chain.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 雷者火也。（《论衡·雷虚》）阴阳之气，感通相动。（《论衡·感虚》）
operation_steps: 追踪现象产生的物质性原因
建立清晰的原因-结果链条
拒绝目的论或神秘感应解释
保持因果链条的内在一致性

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 拒绝将权威、传统或多数人的意见作为真理标准。无论主张来自孔子还是世俗大众，都必须经过独立检验。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Rejecting authority, tradition, or popular opinion as truth standard. Whatever claim from Confucius or common people, it must undergo independent verification.
thinking_modes.source_text_zh: 问孔刺孟，不以圣贤为定。（《论衡·问孔》《论衡·刺孟》）违俗独行，独立不惧。（《论衡·别通》）
operation_steps: 识别主张的来源（是否依赖权威）
剥离主张与来源权威的绑定关系
独立检验主张本身的内容
以事实和逻辑而非身份裁定真假

steps_zh: Step 1: 疾虚妄定立场——以'疾虚妄'为核心使命（模式01），确立对所有未经验证主张的批判性姿态，拒斥天命感应、鬼神迷信等主流意识形态
Step 2: 问难法逐层检验——运用'问难法'（模式02）对每一个流行命题进行定义性追问和机制性质疑，要求每个主张明确其运作的因果机制
Step 3: 效验法确认真伪——通过'效验论证法'（模式04）和'常识经验法'（模式07），用日常经验和可观察事实逐一检验主张的可信度
Step 4: 归谬法揭示矛盾——运用'归谬反驳法'（模式05）推导流行主张的逻辑后果，揭示其中隐藏的荒谬性和矛盾性
Step 5: 自然论重建解释——以'天道自然法'（模式03）和'元气自然论'（模式06）为框架，用物质性的气之聚散重建对自然现象的解释体系
steps_en: Step 1: Disease of Falsehood Stance - With 'disease of falsehood' as core mission (mode 01), establish critical posture toward all unverified claims, rejecting popular ideology of heavenly mandate resonance and ghost superstition

Step 2: Questioning Method Layer-by-Layer Test - Apply 'questioning and challenging method' (mode 02) to conduct definitional inquiry and mechanistic questioning of every popular proposition, requiring each claim to specify its causal mechanism

Step 3: Verification Method Truth Determination - Through 'empirical verification method' (mode 04) and 'common sense experience method' (mode 07), test claim credibility one by one using everyday experience and observable facts
Step 4: Reductio Method Contradiction Revelation - Apply 'reductio ad absurdum method' (mode 05) to derive logical consequences of popular claims, revealing hidden absurdity and contradiction

Step 5: Naturalism Rebuilding Explanation - Using 'Heaven-as-Nature method' (mode 03) and 'primordial qi naturalism' (mode 06) as framework, rebuild explanatory system for natural phenomena through material qi condensation and dispersion
expected_zh: 建立中国首个系统性怀疑论哲学体系，以理性批判对抗谶纬神学
确立经验效验作为真理检验的最高标准，超越权威和传统
用自然主义解释取代目的论和感应论，构建气的本体论框架
开创文本批判传统，区分原始经典与后世附会
以气象学、天文学等实证研究为自然主义哲学提供科学支撑
expected_en: Establish China's first systematic skeptical philosophy, confront Chenwei theocracy with rational criticism
Establish empirical verification as the highest standard of truth testing, transcending authority and tradition
Replace teleological and resonance explanations with naturalism, construct qi-based ontological framework
Pioneer textual criticism tradition, distinguish original classics from later accretions
Provide scientific support for naturalistic philosophy through meteorological and astronomical empirical research
case_zh: 雷电自然成因论证：当时社会普遍认为雷电是天怒的表现，是上天惩罚有罪之人的手段。王充在《论衡·雷虚》中首先运用常识经验法——如果雷电是天怒，那么为什么雷电既打人有又打死人，却从不区分善恶？其次运用归谬法——若雷电是天意，则天应能精确识别有罪之人，但现实中往往无罪者被击，这说明雷电并无意识判断能力。最后他提出机械因果解释：雷电不过是阴阳之气相搏产生的火，是自然现象而非意志行为。此论证展示了王充如何将问难法、归谬法、效验法综合运用，层层递进地推翻流行迷信。
case_en: Thunder and Lightning Natural Causation Argument: Society widely believed thunder/lightning was expression of heavenly wrath, Heaven's punishment tool for sinners. In 'Lunheng: Thunder is Void' chapter, Wang Chong first applied common sense experience method - if thunder is heavenly anger, why does it strike people indiscriminately without distinguishing good from evil? Second, applied reductio ad absurdum - if thunder is heavenly will, Heaven should precisely identify guilty persons, but reality often shows innocent being struck, proving thunder has no conscious judgment ability. Finally he proposed mechanical causal explanation: thunder/lightning merely fire produced by yin-yang qi collision, natural phenomenon not volitional act. This argument demonstrates how Wang Chong comprehensively applied questioning method, reductio method, and empirical verification method in progressive layers to overturn popular superstition.
intellectual_tradition: 东汉唯物主义/元气自然论/批判理性主义

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以自身仁爱为起点，通过'己所不欲，勿施于人'的恕道原则，建立普遍的道德实践体系。仁是内在的道德情感，恕是推己及人的方法，二者构成伦理体系的核心。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Starting from personal benevolence, through the principle of 'Do not do unto others what you would not want done to yourself', establish a universal moral practice system. Ren is internal moral feeling, Shu is the method of extending oneself to others; together they form the core of the ethical system.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《论语·卫灵公》《论语·里仁》《论语·颜渊》
process: 反思自身的感受和欲望
将心比心，理解他人立场
己所不欲勿施于人，己欲立而立人
通过推己及人实现人际和谐

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过确立社会角色的名分与责任，使名实相符，建立有序的社会结构。'名不正则言不顺，言不顺则事不成'是政治秩序的逻辑起点。
thinking_modes.definition_en: By establishing the names and responsibilities of social roles, making names correspond to reality, build an ordered social structure. 'When names are not correct, language is not in accordance with truth; when language is not in accordance with truth, affairs cannot be carried on' is the logical starting point of political order.
process: 明确各社会角色的名分和定位
界定相应角色的责任和权利
使名实相符，言行一致
通过正名建立社会秩序

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 执其两端，用其中于民。无过无不及，恰到好处。中庸不是简单的折中主义，而是在具体情境中寻找恰当平衡点的实践智慧。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Grasp both extremes and apply the mean to the people. Neither excessive nor deficient, but just right. The Doctrine of the Mean is not simple compromise but practical wisdom of finding the appropriate balance point in concrete situations.
process: 识别情境中的两个极端倾向
判断过与不及的具体表现
在两端之间寻找恰当的平衡点
根据情境灵活调整，保持动态平衡

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 视其所以，观其所由，察其所安。根据学生个性、能力、兴趣差异进行针对性教学，实现最大化教育效果。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Observe what a person does, consider the motive, examine where they find contentment. Teach according to individual differences in personality, ability, and interest to achieve maximum educational effectiveness.
process: 了解学生的个性特点和学习需求
分析学生已有的知识基础和能力水平
设计针对性的教学内容和方式
因势利导，启发学生自主学习

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆。将学习与思考有机结合，实现认知螺旋上升，是儒家认识论的核心。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous. Integrate learning and thinking organically to achieve spiral cognitive ascent; this is the core of Confucian epistemology.
process: 广泛学习前人知识和经验
深度思考知识的内在逻辑
将所学与所思相互印证
在学思互动中实现认知跃迁

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 兴于诗，立于礼，成于乐。通过诗、礼、乐的完整路径实现人格的全面发展和文化认同。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Awakened by Poetry, established by Rites, completed by Music. Through the complete path of Poetry, Rites, and Music, achieve comprehensive personality development and cultural identity.
process: 通过诗歌激发情感共鸣
通过礼仪确立行为规范
通过音乐实现人格圆满
在三者统一中完成道德内化

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以君子为理想人格，通过持续修养实现道德完善。君子坦荡荡，小人长戚戚，是人人可及的道德理想。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking the Junzi (gentleman) as ideal character, achieving moral perfection through continuous self-cultivation. The Junzi is open and at ease, the petty man is always anxious — this is a moral ideal accessible to all.
process: 确立君子人格为追求目标
在义利之间选择道义
通过日常修养积累德性
在困境中坚守原则不动摇

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 无可无不可。在坚持原则的前提下根据具体情况采取适当方法，实现灵活应变，是经权统一的决策智慧。
thinking_modes.definition_en: No fixed course of action. Under the premise of adhering to principles, adopt appropriate methods according to specific situations to achieve flexible adaptation. This is the wisdom of unifying constancy and flexibility in decision-making.
process: 识别当前情境的特殊性和时宜性
理解常规原则（经）与变通（权）的边界
根据具体条件灵活调整策略
在变化中保持原则的灵活性

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 温故而知新，可以为师矣。通过复习旧知识获得新理解，实现知识的创新应用和迁移。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Reviewing the old to understand the new — such a person can be a teacher. Through reviewing past knowledge, gain new understanding and achieve innovative application and transfer.
process: 系统回顾和梳理已有知识经验
在新情境中发现旧知识的新意义
通过联想和类比实现知识迁移
将新知识融入已有认知体系

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也。以他人为镜，不断自我完善，是持续成长的实践方法。
thinking_modes.definition_en: When you see a worthy person, think of equaling them; when you see an unworthy person, reflect on yourself. Use others as mirrors for continuous self-improvement; this is the practical method for sustained growth.
process: 识别身边的榜样和反面教材
向优秀者学习，反思不足处
制定改进计划并付诸实践
形成持续自我完善的习惯

steps_zh: Step 1: 仁爱奠基——以'己所不欲，勿施于人'的恕道为起点，建立推己及人的道德实践体系
Step 2: 中庸平衡——在实践中追求过与不及之间的恰当平衡，执两用中
Step 3: 正名立序——通过名实相符确立社会角色和责任，建立有序的社会结构
Step 4: 因材施教——依据个体差异实施个性化教育，实现最大教育效果
Step 5: 学思并进——将学习与思考结合，实现认知螺旋上升
Step 6: 礼乐化成——通过诗礼乐教完成人格的全面发展
Step 7: 君子立身——以君子为理想人格，持续自我完善
Step 8: 时中权变——在坚持原则的前提下灵活应变
steps_en: Step 1: Benevolence Foundation — Start with the Shu Dao principle of 'Do not do unto others what you would not want done to yourself', establish the moral practice system of extending oneself to others
Step 2: Mean Balance — Pursue appropriate balance between excess and deficiency in practice, grasp both extremes and apply the mean
Step 3: Rectification of Names — Establish social roles and responsibilities through correspondence between names and reality, build ordered social structure
Step 4: Personalized Education — Implement personalized teaching based on individual differences to achieve maximum educational effectiveness
Step 5: Learning-Reflection Integration — Combine learning and thinking to achieve spiral cognitive ascent
Step 6: Ritual-Music Cultivation — Complete comprehensive personality development through Poetry, Rites, and Music education
Step 7: Junzi Self-Cultivation — Take the Junzi as ideal character, continuously improve oneself
Step 8: Contextual Flexibility — Adapt flexibly while adhering to principles
expected_zh: 确立以'仁'为核心的伦理体系，成为中国文化的精神底色
开创私人讲学传统，推动教育普及和文化传承
提出因材施教方法论，奠定中国传统教育理论基石
整理编纂六经，保存上古文化遗产
建立君子人格理想，塑造中华民族精神品格
expected_en: Establish the ethical system centered on 'Ren' (benevolence), becoming the spiritual foundation of Chinese culture
Pioneer private teaching tradition, promoting education popularization and cultural transmission
Propose personalized education methodology, laying the cornerstone of traditional Chinese educational theory
Compile the Six Classics, preserving ancient cultural heritage
Establish the Junzi (gentleman) personality ideal, shaping the spiritual character of the Chinese nation
case_zh: 孔子周游列国十四年推行仁政理想；在卫国面对君位之争时明确提出'必也正名乎'；对同一个问题'闻斯行之'，根据子路的勇莽和冉有的谦退给予不同回答，展现因材施教的典范；评价子张'过'、子夏'不及'，指出'过犹不及'的中庸智慧；晚年返鲁修订六经，将上古文化遗产系统化整理传承。这些案例展示了孔子思维模式的完整实践链。
case_en: Confucius traveled through various states for fourteen years promoting his ren-zheng ideals; when facing succession disputes in Wei, he clearly proposed 'must rectify the names'; for the same question 'hear and act', he gave different answers based on Zi Lu's勇莽 and Ran You's humility, demonstrating the paradigm of personalized education; he evaluated Zi Zhang as 'excessive' and Zi Xia as 'deficient', pointing out the Zhong-Yong wisdom that 'excess is as bad as deficiency'; in his late years returned to Lu to compile the Six Classics, systematically organizing and transmitting ancient cultural heritage. These cases demonstrate the complete practical chain of Confucius' thinking modes.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以太虚为气的本然状态，认为宇宙根本实体是气而非空无，万物由气凝聚而成，气散则复归太虚。此法通过确立气的本体地位，构建完整的物质宇宙论，反对佛道的虚无主义。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking Tai Xu (Great Emptiness) as the original state of qi, this method holds that the fundamental substance of the universe is qi rather than nothingness. All phenomena arise from the condensation of qi, and when qi disperses, it returns to Tai Xu. This method establishes qi as the ontological foundation to construct a complete materialist cosmology, opposing Buddhist and Daoist nihilism.
process_steps_zh: 确立气的本体地位，否定"有生于无"
理解太虚为气的本然状态而非绝对虚空
认识万物为气的凝聚形态
把握气的聚散变化为宇宙运行的根本规律

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 认为矛盾对立是宇宙的根本现象（"有象斯有对"），但最终必然走向和解统一（"仇必和而解"）。此法超越了简单的对立思维，主张在矛盾冲突中寻求动态平衡与和谐统一。
thinking_modes.definition_en: This method holds that contradictory opposition is a fundamental phenomenon of the universe ('where there is form, there is opposition'), but ultimately harmony and unity will prevail ('enmity must resolve in harmony'). It transcends simple dualistic thinking, advocating for dynamic balance and harmonious unity amid contradictory conflicts.
process_steps_zh: 识别矛盾对立面（"有象斯有对"）
理解对立面的相互依存关系（"对必反其为"）
认识矛盾冲突的必然性（"有反斯有仇"）
寻求并最终实现和解统一（"仇必和而解"）

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将天地视为父母、所有人视为同胞、万物视为伴侣的普遍关怀方法。此法超越了血缘和地缘的限制，构建了以宇宙为家庭的全人类共同体伦理观。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Treating Heaven and Earth as parents, all people as siblings, and all things as companions, this method constructs a universal care framework that transcends blood and geographic limitations, forming an ethics of global community with the universe as a family.
process_steps_zh: 以天地为父母建立宇宙亲情观
将所有人视为同胞兄弟
将万物视为伴侣朋友
在实践中践行普遍的关爱与责任

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过扩充心的境界来体认天下万物，超越见闻之知的狭隘局限，达到德性之知的高远境界。此法是张载认识论的核心，强调直觉体悟超越感官经验。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Through expanding the mind's scope to embody all things in the world, transcending the narrow limitations of sensory knowledge to reach the profound state of moral knowledge. This is the core of Zhang Zai's epistemology, emphasizing intuitive realization beyond sensory experience.
process_steps_zh: 识别见闻之知的局限性
扩充心的境界以体认天下万物
达到"视天下无一物非我"的境界
以德性之知统摄见闻之知

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将知识分为见闻之知与德性之知两类，认为真正的道德智慧来源于内在德性的自觉，而非外在感官经验。此法强调道德认知的先验性与超越性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Dividing knowledge into sensory knowledge and moral knowledge, this method holds that true moral wisdom stems from inner moral consciousness rather than external sensory experience. It emphasizes the a priori and transcendent nature of moral cognition.
process_steps_zh: 区分见闻之知与德性之知
认识见闻之知的局限（"不萌于见闻"）
通过"德盛仁熟"体认德性之知
以德性之知指导道德实践

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过道德修养和实践改变先天的气质之性，恢复纯粹的天地之性。此法是张载伦理学的核心方法，强调后天修养对于人性完善的重要性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Through moral cultivation and practice, transforming one's physical nature to restore the pure heavenly nature. This is the core method of Zhang Zai's ethics, emphasizing the importance of 后天 cultivation for human perfection.
process_steps_zh: 认识天地之性与气质之性的区别
理解气质之性是恶的来源
通过"知礼成性"修养功夫变化气质
最终达到"天地之性存焉"的圣人境界

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 认为任何事物都包含阴阳两个对立面，两体合一构成事物的本质。此法是张载辩证思维的核心，强调对立统一是宇宙运行的根本规律。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Holding that any thing contains yin and yang as two opposing aspects, whose unity constitutes the essence of the thing. This is the core of Zhang Zai's dialectical thinking, emphasizing that the unity of opposites is the fundamental law of cosmic operation.
process_steps_zh: 认识事物的双重属性（"一物两体"）
理解阴阳的对立统一关系
把握"两不立则一不可见"的辩证关系
运用一物两体思维分析和解决问题

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将哲学思考转化为经世济民的实际政策，主张通过恢复三代之法（井田、封建、礼乐）来解决当时的社会问题。此法体现了张载思想强烈的现实关怀与实践取向。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Transforming philosophical reflection into practical governance for the benefit of the people, advocating the restoration of the Three Dynasties' methods (well-field system, feudal enfeoffment, ritual and music) to address contemporary social problems. This method reflects Zhang Zai's strong practical orientation.
process_steps_zh: 诊断社会问题的根源（贫富不均等）
寻求古代理想制度的参照
设计具体的政策方案（井田、礼俗）
在实践中推行验证

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 强调学习过程中心的体悟比机械记忆更重要，主张"守旧无功"、"学贵心悟"。此法是张载方法论的核心，体现了对主体性思维的重视。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Emphasizing that heart-intuition in learning is more important than mechanical memorization, advocating 'rejecting the old is without merit' and 'learning values heart-intuition'. This is the core of Zhang Zai's methodology, reflecting the importance of subjective thinking.
process_steps_zh: 以疑问为学习的起点
通过心的体悟来理解义理
质疑守旧观念，追求创新
在理解基础上形成个人洞见

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过学习和践行礼仪规范来成就和完善人的本性，将外在的礼内化为内在的德性。此法是张载道德实践的核心路径。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Through learning and practicing ritual norms to achieve and perfect human nature, internalizing external li (ritual propriety) as internal virtue. This is the core path of Zhang Zai's moral practice.
process_steps_zh: 学习礼的规范与意义
在实践中践行礼的要求
将礼内化为自身的德性
达到"从心所欲不逾矩"的境界

steps_zh: 第1步：太虚即气——张载创立：以气为本体的宇宙论体系
第2步：仇必和而解——张载创新：矛盾调和辩证法
第3步：民胞物与——张载扩展：宇宙伦理共同体
第4步：大心体物与德性之知——张载深化：直觉认知体系
第5步：变化气质与知礼成性——张载修养：人性完善路径
第6步：一物两体——张载辩证：对立统一规律
第7步：经世致用——张载实践：社会治理方法
第8步：学贵心悟——张载方法论：主体性思维
第9步：横渠四句——张载凝聚：士大夫精神使命
steps_en: Step 1: Tai Xu as Qi — Zhang Zai Creation: Qi-based cosmological system
Step 2: Enmity Must Resolve in Harmony — Zhang Zai Innovation: Harmonious dialectics
Step 3: Universal Kinship — Zhang Zai Extension: Cosmic ethical community
Step 4: Expanding Heart and Moral Knowledge — Zhang Zai Deepening: Intuitive cognition system
Step 5: Transforming Nature and Ritual Cultivation — Zhang Zai Practice: Human perfection path
Step 6: Unity of Opposites — Zhang Zai Dialectics: Law of unity of opposites
Step 7: Practical Governance — Zhang Zai Application: Social governance method
Step 8: Heart-Intuition Learning — Zhang Zai Methodology: Subjective thinking
Step 9: Hengqu Four Sentences — Zhang Zai Condensation: Scholar-official spiritual mission
expected_zh: 《正蒙》成为宋明理学经典
关学成为宋代理学四大流派之一
横渠四句成为士大夫精神最高表达
民胞物与成为生态伦理先驱思想
expected_en: 'Zheng Meng' becomes a classic of Song-Ming Neo-Confucianism
Guan School becomes one of the four major schools of Song Neo-Confucianism
Hengqu Four Sentences becomes the highest expression of scholar-official spirit
People as Siblings, Things as Companions becomes pioneering ecological ethics thought
case_zh: 张载少年喜谈兵，欲结客取洮西之地。21岁时上书范仲淹《边议九条》，范仲淹劝其读《中庸》。后遍读佛老之书，觉其不能回应儒家根本问题，遂回归六经，融会贯通，创立关学。熙宁二年入朝，与王安石论新政不合，退居横渠讲学著书。晚年主持关中乡约，躬行礼教。其主要著述有《正蒙》《横渠易说》《经学理窟》等。最著名的《西铭》原为《正蒙·乾称篇》末章，后被二程分离单行，影响深远。其「为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平」被冯友兰称为「横渠四句」，成为中国知识分子的精神坐标。
case_en: Zhang Zai was fond of military affairs in his youth. At 21, he presented 'Nine Propositions on Border Defense' to Fan Zhongyan, who advised him to study the Doctrine of the Mean. After extensively reading Buddhist and Daoist texts, he found them inadequate for addressing fundamental Confucian questions, returned to the Six Classics, and founded the Guan School. In 1069, he entered court but disagreed with Wang Anshi's reforms, retired to Hengqu to teach and write. His major works include 'Zheng Meng', 'Hengqu Yishuo', and 'Jingxue Liku'. His famous 'Western Inscription' was originally the final chapter of 'Zheng Meng' and was later separated by the Cheng brothers. His 'Four Sentences' were called by Feng Youlan the spiritual coordinate of Chinese intellectuals.

famous_quote: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻；养吾浩然之气；行有不得者，皆反求诸己
historical_significance: 战国中期邹国人，儒家学派最重要的代表人物，被后世尊为'亚圣'。名轲，字子舆。游历齐、梁、滕、薛诸国推销仁政主张，虽未被采纳却留下最具感染力的论辩文本。其思想以性善论为根基，提出四端之心、仁政学说、民本主义、养气工夫等核心概念，对中国思想影响深远。
influence: 被尊为'亚圣'，与孔子并称'孔孟'，开创性善论哲学体系，影响宋明理学、朝鲜性理学、日本朱子学、法国启蒙思想家及当代新儒家，是中国政治哲学民本传统的奠基者。
representative_works: 《孟子》七篇（梁惠王、公孙丑、滕文公、离娄、万章、告子、尽心）
core_thoughts: 民本优先级法（民贵君轻）

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 道德心理学/伦理学基础
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 主张人性本善，恻隐、羞恶、辞让、是非四端之心是人天生固有的道德潜能，如同四肢般自然存在。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature is inherently good; the Four Beginnings (compassion, shame, deference, sense of right and wrong) are innate moral potentials as natural as four limbs.
process_zh: 识别情境中的道德直觉反应
确认四端之心作为道德能力的先天依据
将直觉反应确认为道德能力的萌芽
通过实践和教育扩充四端为完整德性
process_en: Identify moral intuition in context (compassion, shame, deference, right/wrong)
Confirm Four Beginnings as a priori basis for moral capacity
Recognize intuitions as germination of moral ability
Expand Four Beginnings into complete virtue through practice and education
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人性之善也，犹水之就下也。无人不有善，水无有不下
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The goodness of human nature is like water flowing downward. There is nothing not good in humans, just as there is no water that does not flow downward.
representative_cases_zh: 孺子入井论证恻隐之心
牛山之木比喻本性丧失

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 从亲亲之情出发，层层外推至仁民、爱物。老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Starting from love of one's own family, extend layer by layer to loving people and all things. Respect your own elders and extend that respect to others' elders; care for your own children and extend that care to others' children.
process_zh: 确认当下真实的情感体验
将情感视为可推广的道德种子
进行类比思考：若爱我的亲人，他人亦爱其亲人
将同理心扩展至陌生人、他国之人、万物
process_en: Confirm current genuine emotional experience
Treat emotion as seed of moral expansion
Analogical thinking: if I love my family, others also love theirs
Extend empathy to strangers, foreign people, all things
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 老吾老，以及人之老；幼吾幼，以及人之幼
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Respect your own elders, and extend that respect to others' elders; care for your own children, and extend that care to others' children.
representative_cases_zh: 齐宣王以羊易牛
modern_applications_zh: 生态伦理与全球伦理扩展
modern_applications_en: Ecological ethics and global ethics extension

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过具体情境或故事类比揭示抽象道理。善用寓言如揠苗助长、缘木求鱼等经典案例。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using concrete situations or stories as analogies to reveal abstract principles. Skillful use of fables such as 'pulling seedlings to help them grow' and 'seeking fish by climbing a tree'.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《孟子·公孙丑上》《孟子·梁惠王上》
process_zh: 识别待论证的抽象命题
寻找与之结构相似的具体情境
确保类比对象在关键属性上与目标一致
通过类比推导得出结论
process_en: Identify the abstract proposition to be argued
Find concrete situation with similar structure
Ensure key attributes match between analogy and target
Derive conclusion through the analogy
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 揠苗助长、缘木求鱼等经典寓言
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Classic fables such as 'pulling shoots to help them grow' and 'seeking fish by climbing a tree'.
representative_cases_zh: 揠苗助长
缘木求鱼

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 先让对方表态或承认前提，再通过连续追问引导其陷入逻辑困境。
thinking_modes.definition_en: First state their position, then lead them into logical difficulties through continuous questioning.
process_zh: 让对方先陈述立场
确认对方立场的内在逻辑
通过连续提问揭示立场的隐含后果
引导对方发现逻辑矛盾
process_en: Let opponent first state their position
Confirm the internal logic of opponent's position
Reveal implicit consequences through questioning
Guide opponent to discover logical contradiction
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 王何必曰利？亦有仁义而已矣
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Why must Your Majesty speak of profit? There is only benevolence and righteousness.
representative_cases_zh: 梁惠王论义利

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 严格区分道义价值与功利计算，主张先义后利。当义利冲突时选择义而非利。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Strictly distinguishing moral value from utilitarian calculation, righteousness takes priority over interest. Choose righteousness when they conflict.
process_zh: 识别情境中的义利结构
区分短期利益与长期道义
评估各选项的义利权重
在冲突时坚持义优先原则
process_en: Identify righteousness-interest structure in the context
Distinguish short-term interest from long-term moral value
Evaluate righteousness-interest weight of each option
Adhere to righteousness-first principle when conflict arises
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 鱼，我所欲也；熊掌，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Fish is what I desire; bear paw is also what I desire. If both cannot be had, I give up fish and take bear paw.
representative_cases_zh: 梁惠王论义利
舍生取义
modern_applications_zh: 商业伦理与公共政策评估
modern_applications_en: Business ethics and public policy evaluation

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 将民众福祉置于政治优先级的最高位置。民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Placing people's welfare at the highest political priority. The people are most important, the state next, the ruler least.
process_zh: 评估政策的民众影响
优先保障基本生存需求
在此基础上推行道德教化
以民众满意度作为政治合法性指标
process_en: Assess popular impact of policies
Prioritize basic survival needs (secure livelihood)
Implement moral education on this foundation
Use people's satisfaction as political legitimacy indicator
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The people are most important, the state next, the ruler least.
representative_cases_zh: 民贵君轻宣言

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过持续道德实践培育浩然之气，使精神力量不为外物所动。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Cultivating flood-like qi through sustained moral practice, making spiritual strength impervious to external perturbations.
process_zh: 确认自己的道德志向
在日常实践中累积义行
察觉浩然之气的生长征象
保持意志坚定，不暴其气
process_en: Confirm one's moral intention
Accumulate righteous acts in daily practice
Perceive signs of qi growth
Maintain firm will without depleting one's qi
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 我善养吾浩然之气
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: I am good at nourishing my flood-like qi.
representative_cases_zh: 养气法
modern_applications_zh: 道德品格培养与领导力修养
modern_applications_en: Moral character cultivation and leadership development

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 假设对方观点正确，推导其逻辑后果，若后果荒诞则原观点错误。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Assuming opponent's view is correct, derive its logical consequences; if consequences are absurd or unacceptable, the original view fails.
process_zh: 清晰表述对手的核心主张
暂时假设该主张为真
推导该主张的逻辑后果
若后果荒诞或矛盾，则归谬成功
process_en: Clearly state opponent's core position
Temporarily assume the position is true
Derive logical consequences of that position
If consequences are absurd or contradictory, reductio succeeds
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人性之善也，犹水之就下也
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The goodness of human nature is like water flowing downward.
representative_cases_zh: 与告子辩论人性

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 政治外交/领导力灵活应变
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 根据时势和身份地位灵活调整行为方式。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Adapting behavior flexibly according to circumstances and status.
process_zh: 识别当前时势的特征
评估自己的身份地位与责任
判断何时应进取、何时应退守
根据情境调整行为方式
process_en: Identify current circumstances
Assess one's status and responsibilities
Judge when to advance and when to retreat
Adjust methods while keeping principles constant
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 可以速则速，可以久则久，可以平则平，可以险则险
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When speed is appropriate, be quick; when lasting is appropriate, stay long.
representative_cases_zh: 孟子评价三位圣人
modern_applications_zh: 政治外交与领导力灵活应变

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 遇到问题或挫折时，首先反省自身而非责怪他人。
thinking_modes.definition_en: When encountering problems or setbacks, first examine oneself rather than blaming others.
process_zh: 遭遇挫败时暂停对外归因
逐项检视自身行为是否合乎道义
诚实评估自己的动机与努力
制定修正计划并付诸实践
process_en: Pause external attribution when facing setbacks
Examine whether one's behavior aligns with moral principles
Honestly assess one's motives and efforts
Formulate a correction plan and put it into practice
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 行有不得者，皆反求诸己
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When something does not work, examine oneself.
representative_cases_zh: 反求诸己
modern_applications_zh: 领导力发展与冲突解决

summary_zh: 孟子（约前372-前289）名轲，战国中期邹国人，儒家学派最重要代表人物，被尊为「亚圣」。核心思维模式：M201 性善本源法, M202 推恩扩充法, M203 类比论证法, M204 诘问诱敌法, M205 义利之辨法, M206 民本优先级法, M207 养气持志法, M208 归谬反驳法, M209 时位变通法, M210 反求诸己法。
summary_en: Mencius (c. 372-289 BCE), named Meng Ke, from Zou State in mid-Warring States period, most important representative of Confucianism honored as Second Sage. Core thinking modes: M201 (Source of Good Nature Method), M202 (Expanding Kindness Method), M203 (Analogical Reasoning Method), M204 (Leading Question Technique), M205 (Righteousness-Interest Distinction Method), M206 (People-First Priority Method), M207 (Nourishing Qi Method), M208 (Reductio Ad Absurdum Method), M209 (Situational Flexibility Method), M210 (Self-Reflection Method).

modes.definition_zh: 通过灾异祥瑞解读天意，建立天—君双向契约的政治制衡机制。天降灾异谴告君主失道，君主修省则灾异消退。
modes.definition_en: Decode Heaven's will through auspicious/inauspicious phenomena to establish a heavenly-imperial bilateral contract for political checks. Heaven sends disasters to warn of imperial failure; imperial correction leads to natural restoration.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·灾异》《汉书·董仲舒传》天人三策第一策
process: 观测异常现象——记录灾异祥瑞的具体内容
解读天意指向——根据阴阳五行理论解读灾异的含义
对应人事过失——将灾异与具体政治问题关联
提出修正建议——给出君主修省的具体方案
modern_applications: 组织治理中的反馈—修正机制设计
危机预警系统的理论模型构建
领导层问责机制的哲学基础

modes.definition_zh: 以《春秋》经义断狱，建立原心论罪原则。判断案件不只看行为结果，更要追溯行为动机，志善而违于法者免，志恶而符合法者诛。
modes.definition_en: Adjudicate cases using Spring and Autumn Annals principles, establishing the 'mind-centered guilt' standard. Judge not only by behavioral outcomes but by motives: those with good intentions who violate law are spared; those with evil intentions who comply with law are punished.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·深察名号》《汉书·董仲舒传》
process: 识别案件疑难——发现律文无法直接适用的矛盾情境
援引《春秋》经义——寻找与案情相类的历史典故或道德原则
探求行为本心——分析当事人主观动机是否符合仁义
作出经义裁决——以道德判断修正或超越形式法律
modern_applications: 法律裁量中的动机考量
道德判断与法律条文冲突时的权衡
司法解释中的实质正义追求

modes.name_en: Three Bonds and Five Constants Method
modes.definition_zh: 将伦理关系宇宙化本体化。以阴阳论证君为臣纲、父为子纲、夫为妻纲的正当性；以五行配仁义礼智信，建立永恒不变的社会伦理秩序。
modes.definition_en: Cosmologize and ontologize ethical relationships. Use yin-yang to justify the Three Bonds (ruler-minister, father-son, husband-wife); use five elements to map the Five Constants (benevolence, righteousness, ritual, wisdom, trustworthiness), establishing an eternal social ethical order.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·基义》《春秋繁露·王道》
process: 确立阴阳尊卑结构——以自然现象论证社会等级
映射伦理关系——将君臣、父子、夫妇对应阳阴关系
配套五常德行——仁义礼智信对应五行运行
制度化推广——编入律令、教育体系，形成社会规范
modern_applications: 社会规范合法性的哲学论证
企业文化价值观的体系化设计

modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳论证德主刑辅。阳主生配德，阴主杀配刑；阳尊阴卑决定德优先于刑。德为经（常道），刑为权（变通），刑只在「可以然之域」内使用。
modes.definition_en: Use yin-yang to argue virtue-dominant punishment-assistant. Yang (life-giving) maps to virtue; yin (killing) maps to punishment. Yang's precedence means virtue takes priority over punishment. Virtue is the constant (jing), punishment is the flexible (quan)—punishment only valid within its proper domain.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·阳尊阴卑》《春秋繁露·玉英》《汉书·董仲舒传》
process: 建立阴阳—德刑对应——以德配阳、以刑配阴
确立德主刑辅原则——阳尊阴卑决定德优先于刑
引入经权辩证——德为经（常道），刑为权（变通）
设定使用边界——刑只在「可以然之域」内使用
modern_applications: 治理中激励与约束的辩证关系
制度设计中原则与灵活性的平衡
绩效管理中正向激励与负向约束的配比

modes.definition_zh: 以大一统为宇宙法则，确立儒家为正统，通过太学五经博士制度建立意识形态再生产体系。不靠暴力压制，而靠制度设计使异学自然衰微。
modes.definition_en: Take Great Unity as cosmic law, establish Confucianism as orthodoxy, and build ideological reproduction through the Grand Academy and Five Classics professorship system. Do not suppress by violence but by institutional design.
modes.source_chapter: 《汉书·董仲舒传》天人三策第二策《春秋繁露·五行相生》
process: 论证大一统的宇宙论基础——以《春秋》公羊学证明统一是天道
确立儒家正统地位——六艺之科、孔子之术为唯一合法知识
建立人才培养管道——五经博士、太学、贤良方正三级体系
制度化排斥异学——不在六艺者不得并进
modern_applications: 组织文化统一与核心价值观建设
知识生产体系的制度化设计
行业标准制定中的主流范式确立

modes.definition_zh: 历史在白统、赤统、黄统三者间循环。新王必改制（改正朔、易服色）但不易道（三纲五常永恒）。改制提供合法性，守道保持连续性。
modes.definition_en: History cycles through White, Red, and Yellow Ordinances. A new king must reformat (change calendar, colors, names) but cannot change the Dao (Three Bonds and Five Constants are eternal). Reformatting provides legitimacy; preserving the Dao maintains continuity.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·三代改制质文》《春秋繁露·楚庄王》
process: 确定当前统绪——判断王朝在三统中的位置
设计改制方案——改正朔、易服色、变官名等象征性革新
论证合法性来源——以天命循环证明新王受命
保持道统连续性——改制不改道，维护文化延续
modern_applications: 组织变革中继承与创新的平衡
历史周期规律的应用预测
企业重组中核心价值观的传承与形式创新

modes.definition_zh: 大一统是天地常经、古今通谊。通过差序格局（内国、外诸夏、外夷狄）实现有等级的统一，配合制度设计（郡县、察举、太学）达成政治—思想—文化三位一体的整合。
modes.definition_en: Great Unity is the constant principle of Heaven and Earth, the universal truth of past and present. Achieve hierarchical unity through differential order (inner state, outer vassals, outer barbarians), combined with institutional design (commanderies, recommendation system, Grand Academy) for political-ideological-cultural integration.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·大一统》《汉书·董仲舒传》天人三策第三策
process: 论证大一统的宇宙论必然性——天地常经、古今通谊
构建差序格局——内国、外诸夏、外夷狄的层次结构
制度设计——郡县制、察举制、太学制的配合
文化整合——统一思想来源，确立道统传承
modern_applications: 复杂组织的系统整合设计
多元化体系的一体化协调
跨文化管理的统一框架构建

modes.definition_zh: 建立自然—政治反馈回路：君主失道→天降灾异→君主修省→灾异消退。把不可控的自然现象转化为可控的政治信号，为士大夫制约皇权提供方法论工具。
modes.definition_en: Establish nature-politics feedback loop: imperial failure→Heaven sends disaster→imperial reflection→disaster recedes. Transform uncontrollable natural phenomena into controllable political signals, providing methodological tools for scholars to check imperial power.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·灾异》《春秋繁露·必仁且智》
process: 观测异常现象——记录灾异祥瑞的具体内容
解读天意指向——根据阴阳五行理论解读灾异的含义
对应人事过失——将灾异与具体政治问题关联
提出修正建议——给出君主修省的具体方案
modern_applications: 组织危机预警系统设计
政治问责机制的方法论构建
外部环境变化的内部归因机制

modes.name_en: Three Grades of Nature Education Method
modes.definition_zh: 人性分三品：圣人不教而善（上智）、中民待教而善（中人）、斗筲不教而恶（下愚）。以此为依据设计分层教化体系，因材施教，礼仪法度师法教化。
modes.definition_en: Human nature has three grades: sages are good without teaching (highest), commoners become good through teaching (middle), base people are evil without teaching (lowest). Design tiered education system accordingly, teach according to aptitude, use ritual and law as teaching tools.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·玉英》《春秋繁露·精华》
process: 识别人性等级——区分圣人、中民、斗筲三品
设计分层方案——针对不同等级制定教化策略
实施礼法教化——以礼仪法度为教化工具
评估教化效果——通过考绩绌陟验证成果
modern_applications: 人才分层培养体系设计
组织中高潜人才与普通员工的分类发展

modes.definition_zh: 以阴阳五行为通用类比框架，将自然现象、社会关系、政治制度、道德规范纳入同一解释系统。同类相动、以类合以数偶，实现跨域概念映射与推理。
modes.definition_en: Use yin-yang and five elements as universal analogical framework, incorporating natural phenomena, social relations, political institutions, and moral norms into a single explanatory system. Same-category resonance, matching by category and number, achieving cross-domain concept mapping and reasoning.
modes.source_chapter: 《春秋繁露·阴阳义》《春秋繁露·同类相动》《春秋繁露·天地阴阳》
process: 建立阴阳五行分类体系——将万物纳入阴阳五行框架
识别同类关系——寻找不同领域中同阴阳五行属性的事物
进行类比映射——利用同类相动原理跨域推理
得出规范性结论——从自然规律推导社会政治道德准则
modern_applications: 系统思维中的模式识别
复杂系统的同构性分析

school: 儒家政治哲学/朝代治理理论

thinking_modes.name_zh: 天命承继法/中央集权法/文官治国法
thinking_modes.name_en: Mandate of Heaven Succession / Centralization Method / Civil Governance
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过天命承继法确立政权合法性，以中央集权法实现国家统一与治理效率，以文官治国法建立科举制等人才选拔机制确保治理质量。三者结合构成朝代政治思维的基础框架：天命承继解决'为何统治'，中央集权解决'如何统一'，文官治国解决'谁来治理'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish regime legitimacy through Mandate of Heaven Succession, achieve national unity and governance efficiency through centralization, ensure governance quality by establishing talent selection mechanisms such as the imperial examination system via civil governance. The three together form the foundational framework of dynastic political thinking: Mandate addresses 'why rule', centralization addresses 'how to unify', civil governance addresses 'who governs'.
process_zh: 确立合法性——通过天命叙事、历史正统性论证政权正当性
构建集权体制——建立中央集权的行政、军事、财政体系
选拔治理人才——通过科举等制度筛选文官精英
维持治理运转——官僚体系的日常运作与考核
process_en: Establish legitimacy—legitimize regime through mandate narratives and historical orthodoxy
Build central system—establish centralized administrative, military, fiscal apparatus
Select governing talent—select scholar-official elites via imperial examination etc.
Maintain governance operations—the daily operation and evaluation of bureaucracy
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 天命靡常，惟德是辅。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The Mandate of Heaven is not constant; it supports only the virtuous.
representative_cases_zh: 周朝建立——以天命取代商朝，确立宗法制和分封制
秦汉大一统——秦始皇废除分封实行郡县，汉武帝独尊儒术
隋唐科举制——以考试选拔文官，打破门阀垄断

thinking_modes.name_zh: 文官治国法/因时制宜法/民本仁政法
thinking_modes.name_en: Civil Governance / Adaptive Governance / People-Centered Benevolent Governance
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以文官体系为核心治理主体，根据时代变化灵活调整政策（因时制宜），同时坚持民本仁政的治理理念。三者结合体现了朝代政治中'人治'与'法治'、'守成'与'变革'的辩证统一。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Center governance on the civil bureaucracy, flexibly adjust policies according to changing times (adaptive governance), while adhering to people-centered benevolent governance. The three together embody the dialectical unity of 'rule by persons' and 'rule by law', 'conservation' and 'reform' in dynastic politics.
process_zh: 选拔贤能——通过科举等制度筛选治国人才
因时变革——根据时代特点灵活调整政策方向
施行仁政——关注民生，减轻赋税，休养生息
平衡治理——文官体系与制度建设的动态平衡
process_en: Select the capable—select governing talent via imperial examination etc.
Adaptive reform—adjust policies flexibly according to changing times
Implement benevolent governance—focus on people's livelihood, reduce taxes, allow recuperation
Balance governance—the dynamic balance between bureaucracy and institutional building
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The people are the most important, the state comes next, and the ruler is the least.
representative_cases_zh: 汉初休养生息——轻徭薄赋，恢复民生
贞观之治——唐太宗以民为本，虚心纳谏
王安石变法——因时制宜的制度改革尝试

thinking_modes.name_zh: 礼法并重法/夷夏之辨法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.name_en: Rite-Law Dualism / Civilized-Barbarian Distinction / Harmonious Unity
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过礼法并重实现社会规范与法律约束的统一，以夷夏之辨维护文化认同和民族融合，最终追求社会各阶层的和谐统一。三者构成朝代社会治理的核心框架：礼法并重解决'如何规范'，夷夏之辨解决'谁是共同体成员'，和谐统一解决'社会目标是什么'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Achieve the unity of social norms and legal constraints through rite-law dualism, maintain cultural identity and ethnic integration via civilized-barbarian distinction, ultimately pursue harmonious unity across all social strata. The three form the core framework of dynastic social governance: rite-law addresses 'how to regulate', civilized-barbarian distinction addresses 'who is a member of the community', harmonious unity addresses 'what is society's goal'.
process_zh: 制定礼法——建立道德规范与法律制度的统一体系
辨别夷夏——通过文化认同构建民族融合的基础
追求和谐——实现社会各阶层的共存与协调
维持秩序——礼法并用维护社会稳定
process_en: Formulate rites and laws—establish the unified system of moral norms and legal institutions
Distinguish civilized from barbarian—build foundation for ethnic integration through cultural identity
Pursue harmony—achieve coexistence and coordination across social strata
Maintain order—the combined use of rites and laws to maintain social stability
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 礼者，天地之序也；法者，天下之程也。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Rites are the order of heaven and earth; laws are the measure of all under heaven.
representative_cases_zh: 孔子德主刑辅——道德教化与法律约束相结合
荀子隆礼重法——礼法并重的治理模式
清朝民族融合政策——从'天下一家'理念推进夷夏融合
modern_applications_zh: 社会治理中的德法兼治

thinking_modes.name_zh: 开拓进取法/治乱循环法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.name_en: Pioneering Spirit / Cyclic Governance Method / Harmonious Unity
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过开拓进取推动国家疆域拓展和文明进步，以治乱循环法总结历史兴衰规律，最终指向和谐统一的社会理想。三者构成朝代政治的战略思维框架：开拓进取解决'如何发展'，治乱循环法解决'兴衰规律是什么'，和谐统一解决'最终目标是什么'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Promote territorial expansion and civilizational progress through pioneering spirit, summarize the laws of rise and fall through cyclic governance method, ultimately pointing to a harmonious unified social ideal. The three form the strategic thinking framework of dynastic politics: pioneering addresses 'how to develop', cyclic governance addresses 'what are the rise/fall patterns', harmonious unity addresses 'what is the ultimate goal'.
process_zh: 开拓进取——通过军事扩张、制度改革推动国家发展
总结规律——从朝代兴衰中提炼治乱循环的历史经验
追求统一——实现社会各阶层的和谐共存与共同发展
process_en: Pioneering development—promote national progress through territorial expansion and institutional reform
Summarize patterns—extract historical lessons of rise/fall cycles from dynastic history
Pursue unity—achieve harmonious coexistence and common development across all social strata
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 以铜为镜，可以正衣冠；以古为镜，可以知兴替；以人为镜，可以明得失。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: With bronze as a mirror, one can adjust one's attire; with history as a mirror, one can understand rise and fall; with people as a mirror, one can see gains and losses.
representative_cases_zh: 秦朝统一六国——开拓进取的极致体现
汉武帝开疆拓土——汉武盛世的建设性开拓
《资治通鉴》编纂——司马光总结治乱循环的历史智慧
modern_applications_zh: 历史经验总结与政策学习

thinking_modes.name_zh: 和谐统一法/天命承继法/中央集权法
thinking_modes.name_en: Harmonious Unity / Mandate of Heaven Succession / Centralization
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以和谐统一为最终社会目标，通过天命承继法确立政治合法性基础，以中央集权法实现治理效率。三者构成朝代政治的终极理想框架：天命承继解决'政权来源'，中央集权解决'治理手段'，和谐统一解决'最终目的'。这是朝代政治思维的最高境界——天下大同、致中和的理想追求。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Pursue harmonious unity as the ultimate social goal, establish political legitimacy foundation through Mandate of Heaven Succession, achieve governance efficiency via centralization. The three form the ultimate ideal framework of dynastic politics: Mandate addresses 'source of power', centralization addresses 'governance means', harmonious unity addresses 'ultimate purpose'. This is the highest realm of dynastic thinking—the ideal pursuit of universal harmony and achieving centrality-harmony.
process_zh: 确立天命——论证政权的正当性和历史使命
集中权力——建立高效统一的治理体系
构建和谐——实现各阶层的和谐共存与天下大同
process_en: Establish mandate—justify regime's legitimacy and historical mission
Concentrate power—build an efficient unified governance system
Build harmony—achieve harmonious coexistence across all strata and universal great harmony
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 致中和，天地位焉，万物育焉。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When centrality and harmony are achieved, heaven and earth find their place, and all things flourish.
representative_cases_zh: 《礼记·中庸》——'致中和'的哲学基础
康乾盛世——清朝统一多民族国家的治理巅峰
古代大同社会理想——'天下为公'的政治追求

thinking_modes.name_zh: 天命承继法/礼法并重法/开拓进取法
thinking_modes.name_en: Mandate of Heaven Succession / Rite-Law Dualism / Pioneering Spirit
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以天命承继法确立政权合法性，通过礼法并重建立社会规范体系，以开拓进取推动国家疆域和文明的拓展。三者结合体现了朝代政治中'合法性—规范性—发展性'的完整逻辑链条。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish regime legitimacy through Mandate of Heaven Succession, build social normative system via rite-law dualism, promote territorial and civilizational expansion through pioneering spirit. The three together embody the complete logical chain of 'legitimacy—normativity—development' in dynastic politics.
process_zh: 确立合法性——通过天命叙事论证政权正当性
建立规范体系——礼法并重的社会治理框架
推动国家发展——开拓进取实现疆域拓展和文明进步
process_en: Establish legitimacy—justify regime through mandate narratives
Build normative system—the social governance framework of rite-law dualism
Promote national development—pioneering spirit achieves territorial expansion and civilizational progress
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 天视自我民视，天听自我民听。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Heaven sees as the people see; Heaven hears as the people hear.
representative_cases_zh: 周朝制礼作乐——以天命承继为基础建立礼法体系
汉武帝北击匈奴——开拓疆土与维护礼法秩序并重

thinking_modes.name_zh: 中央集权法/文官治国法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以中央集权法实现国家统一和治理效率，通过文官治国法建立人才选拔与治理体系，最终指向和谐统一的社会理想。三者构成朝代行政治理的核心框架：中央集权解决'权力如何集中'，文官治国解决'谁来行使权力'，和谐统一解决'权力为何而用'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Achieve national unity and governance efficiency through centralization, build talent selection and governance system via civil governance, ultimately pointing to harmonious unified social ideal. The three form the core framework of dynastic administrative governance: centralization addresses 'how to concentrate power', civil governance addresses 'who exercises power', harmonious unity addresses 'for what purpose power is used'.
process_zh: 集中权力——建立中央集权的行政体制
选拔人才——通过科举等制度确保治理质量
实现和谐——以民为本的治理目标
process_en: Concentrate power—establish centralized administrative system
Select talent—ensure governance quality via imperial examination etc.
Achieve harmony—the people-centered governance goal
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 天下之势，分久必合，合久必分。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The trend of the world: division leads to unity, unity leads to division.
representative_cases_zh: 秦朝郡县制——中央集权的制度创新
明清内阁与军机处——文官治理体系的成熟

thinking_modes.name_zh: 文官治国法/因时制宜法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.name_en: Civil Governance / Adaptive Governance / Harmonious Unity
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以文官治国法确保治理质量，通过因时制宜法实现政策灵活调整，最终指向和谐统一的社会目标。三者构成朝代政治中'守成—变革—理想'的动态平衡框架：文官治国提供治理基础，因时制宜保证政策活力，和谐统一指明发展方向。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Ensure governance quality through civil governance, achieve flexible policy adjustment via adaptive governance, ultimately pointing to harmonious unified social goal. The three form the dynamic balance framework of 'conservation—reform—ideal' in dynastic politics: civil governance provides the foundation, adaptive governance ensures policy vitality, harmonious unity directs development.
process_zh: 确保治理质量——文官体系的稳定运作
灵活调整政策——因时制宜的制度改革
实现社会和谐——以民为本的最终目标
process_en: Ensure governance quality—the stable operation of bureaucracy
Flexibly adjust policies—adaptive institutional reform
Achieve social harmony—the people-centered ultimate goal
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 穷则变，变则通，通则久。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: When at an impasse, one changes; when changed, one passes through; when passed through, one endures.
representative_cases_zh: 王安石变法——因时制宜的治理改革
张居正改革——明代文官治理的制度创新

thinking_modes.name_zh: 礼法并重法/开拓进取法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.name_en: Rite-Law Dualism / Pioneering Spirit / Harmonious Unity
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过礼法并重建立社会规范，以开拓进取推动文明发展，最终指向和谐统一的社会理想。三者构成朝代文化治理的完整框架：礼法并重解决'社会规范问题'，开拓进取解决'发展动力问题'，和谐统一解决'文化目标问题'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Establish social norms through rite-law dualism, promote civilizational progress through pioneering spirit, ultimately pointing to harmonious unified social ideal. The three form the complete framework of dynastic cultural governance: rite-law addresses 'social norm issues', pioneering spirit addresses 'development motivation', harmonious unity addresses 'cultural goals'.
process_zh: 建立规范——礼法并重的社会秩序
推动发展——开拓进取的文明进步
实现和谐——文化认同与社会共存
process_en: Establish norms—the social order of rite-law dualism
Promote development—civilizational progress through pioneering spirit
Achieve harmony—the cultural identity and social coexistence
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 不同而和，和而不同。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Different yet harmonious, harmonious yet different.
representative_cases_zh: 唐朝文化繁荣——礼法与开拓并重的盛世
清朝民族融合政策——多元文化的和谐统一

thinking_modes.name_zh: 因时制宜法/民本仁政法/和谐统一法
thinking_modes.name_en: Adaptive Governance / People-Centered Benevolent Governance / Harmonious Unity
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 根据时代变化灵活调整政策（因时制宜），坚持民本仁政的治理理念，最终指向和谐统一的社会理想。三者构成朝代政治中'变革—民本—理想'的治理理念框架：因时制宜解决'如何适应变化'，民本仁政解决'为谁治理'，和谐统一解决'治理的最终目的'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Flexibly adjust policies according to changing times (adaptive governance), adhere to people-centered benevolent governance philosophy, ultimately pointing to harmonious unified social ideal. The three form the governance philosophy framework of 'reform—people-centered—ideal' in dynastic politics: adaptive addresses 'how to adapt to change', people-centered addresses 'govern for whom', harmonious unity addresses 'the ultimate purpose of governance'.
process_zh: 适应变化——因时制宜的灵活政策调整
关注民生——民本仁政的治理理念
实现和谐——天下大同的社会理想
process_en: Adapt to change—flexible policy adjustment through adaptive governance
Focus on livelihood—the people-centered benevolent governance philosophy
Achieve harmony—the social ideal of universal great harmony
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 民为贵，社稷次之，君为轻。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The people are the most important, the state comes next, and the ruler is the least.
representative_cases_zh: 汉初休养生息——因时制宜的民本政策
唐太宗贞观之治——以民为本的治国典范

historical_significance.contemporary_impact: 朝代思维模式体系为中国传统政治文明奠定了理论基础，为当代中国治理提供了丰富的思想资源。
historical_significance.limitations: 朝代政治思维受限于封建社会结构；中央集权体制容易导致权力滥用；礼法体系对个体权利关注不足。

research_notes.scholarly_consensus: 朝代政治思想家群体是中国传统政治文明的核心载体，其思维模式体系体现了中华民族的政治智慧和历史经验。

historical_context: 战国末期儒家集大成者，赵国人，曾三为齐稷下学宫祭酒，后游秦国、楚国，由春申君授兰陵令。弟子有韩非、李斯。与孔子、孟子并称'孔孟荀'，为先秦儒家最高峰。
primary_domain: 哲学/政治哲学/伦理学/教育学/语言哲学

thinking_modes.name_en: Human Nature is Evil Foundational Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 从'人之性恶，其善者伪也'出发，将人性视为未经教化的原始材朴，善并非先天固有而是后天人为建构的结果。这一立场不是悲观主义，而是为道德教化与礼法制度奠定必要性与紧迫性的基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Starting from 'human nature is evil, its goodness is artificial', viewing human nature as unrefined raw material. Goodness is not innate but constructed后天 through education and ritual. This is not pessimism but lays the foundation for moral cultivation and institutional design.
process_zh: 正视人性中的自然欲望与自私倾向
识别若放任自流的潜在冲突与混乱
确立外在规范（礼/法）的必要性与来源
设计教化与约束的双重机制
通过持续训练将规范内化为习惯
process_en: Acknowledge natural desires and self-interest in human nature
Identify potential conflicts and chaos if left unchecked
Establish necessity and source of external norms (ritual/law)
Design dual mechanism of education and constraint
Internalize norms through continuous training
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人之性恶，其善者伪也。（《性恶》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Human nature is evil; its goodness is artificial.
representative_cases_zh: 批判孟子性善论——举兄弟争财为例论证道德后天习得
《性恶》篇系统论证——若顺性必导致争夺暴乱
representative_cases_en: Critique of Mencius' good nature——using sibling rivalry as example
Systematic argument in 'Human Nature is Evil' chapter

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 心作为'神明之主'，必须保持'虚'（不以已有知识妨碍新知）、'壹'（专一而不分心）、'静'（不被杂念扰动）的状态，方能达到'大清明'境界，正确认知事物、破除偏见遮蔽。这是荀子核心的认知方法论。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The mind as 'lord of spirit' must maintain 'empty' (not letting prior knowledge block new), 'single' (focused without distraction), 'still' (not disturbed by杂念) to reach 'great clarity' and correctly perceive事物,破除偏见.
process_zh: 保持'虚'：清空先入为主的概念与成见
保持'壹'：专注核心议题，不被无关因素分散
保持'静'：排除情绪波动与杂念干扰
综合观察'兼陈万物'，全面收集信息
以'中悬衡'公正标准衡量判断
process_en: Maintain 'empty': clear preconceptions
Maintain 'single': focus on core issues
Maintain 'still':排除 emotional interference
Observe comprehensively '兼陈万物'
Judge with impartial standard '中悬衡'
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 虚壹而静，谓之大清明。（《解蔽》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Empty, single, and still—this is called great clarity.
representative_cases_zh: 《解蔽》篇批判诸子百家——逐一剖析各家之'蔽'
'心不使焉'之戒——心若不专用则感官形同虚设
representative_cases_en: Critique of various schools in 'Jie Bi' chapter
Warning about '心不使'——mind若不专注则感官失效

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人性的不善并非不可改变，通过'伪'（人为努力、后天学习）可以转化本性。强调'性伪合而天下治'，天性提供质料，人为赋予形式，二者缺一不可。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Human nature's imperfection is not irreversible; through 'artifice' (conscious effort and后天 learning), nature can be transformed. Emphasizes 'when nature and artifice unite, the world is governed'.
process_zh: 承认现状的不足（性之朴）
确立理想的形态与标准（礼义之道）
通过持续的学习与实践进行改造
借助外部环境与师友的帮助（师法之化）
日积月累，使新习惯内化为第二天性
process_en: Acknowledge current deficiencies
Establish ideal standards (ritual-righteousness)
Transform through continuous learning and practice
Utilize external environment and mentorship
Accumulate until new habits become second nature
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 涂之人可以为禹。（《性恶》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Any common person can become Yu (the sage king).
representative_cases_zh: '涂之人可以为禹'——普通人通过后天学习可达圣王境界
'积善成德，而神明自得'——道德是日复一日善行的积累
representative_cases_en: 'Any person can become Yu'——ordinary people can reach sagehood
'Accumulate goodness to become virtue'——morality is accumulation of daily good acts

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 礼与法不是对立而是互补：礼为内在的价值引导与身份区分，法为外在的行为约束与惩罚机制。二者共同构成社会治理的完整框架，礼主法辅，先礼后法。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Ritual and law are not opposing but complementary: ritual provides internal value guidance and identity distinction, law provides external behavioral constraint and punishment. Together they form complete social governance framework.
process_zh: 确立礼义作为价值基础与方向引导
设计明确的行为规范与等级秩序
辅以法律的强制惩罚作为保障
先用教化引导，再用刑罚惩恶
根据情境灵活调整礼法比例
process_en: Establish ritual-righteousness as value foundation
Design clear behavioral norms and hierarchical order
Supplement with legal punishment as guarantee
First educate, then punish
Flexibly adjust ritual-law ratio by situation
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 隆礼尊贤而王，重法爱民而霸。（《大略》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Exalt ritual and revere the worthy—this makes one king; emphasize law and love the people—this makes one hegemon.
representative_cases_zh: 批评纯任法术的申不害、商鞅——肯定法但反对片面
'群居和一'的社会构想——礼法并用实现社会和谐
representative_cases_en: Critique of Shen Buhai and Shang Yang's pure legalism
'Group harmony' social vision—ritual-law combined for social harmony

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天（自然）有其客观规律，不以人的意志为转移；人道与天道各有其职分。人不应祈求天的恩赐，而应认识并利用自然规律'制天命而用之'。这是中国早期朴素唯物主义的标志性命题。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Heaven (nature) has objective laws independent of human will; human affairs and heavenly affairs each have their respective domains. Humans should not pray for heaven's favor but understand and utilize natural laws—'master heaven's mandate and use it'.
process_zh: 区分'天'（自然规律）与'人'（人事努力）各自的领域
认识并掌握自然界的客观规律
不依赖超自然力量的干预
主动利用自然规律为人类服务
在人事范围内尽最大努力
process_en: Distinguish 'heaven' (natural laws) from 'human' (human affairs)
Understand and master objective natural laws
Do not rely on supernatural intervention
Actively utilize natural laws for human service
Exert maximum effort within human domain
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 天行有常，不为尧存，不为桀亡。（《天论》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Heaven's course is constant; it does not exist for Yao nor perish for Jie.
representative_cases_zh: '星坠木鸣'之释——流星雷击是自然现象非天意
'反对占卜祈雨'——旱而求雨无意义，应修水利节用度
representative_cases_en: Explanation of 'falling stars and thunder'—natural phenomena not heavenly will
Opposition to divination for rain—practical water management instead
modern_applications_zh: 自然科学与技术的理性态度
modern_applications_en: Rational attitude toward natural science and technology

thinking_modes.name_en: Regulate Names to Point to Reality Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 名称是社会约定的符号，用以指称客观事物。名称无固定适宜，由社会'约定俗成'而确立；同时可通过'循旧作新'发展新名。正名的目的是'明贵贱、辨同异'，使名实相符、言意相通。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Names are socially约定的 symbols used to point to objective reality. Names have no fixed appropriateness; they are established through social 'convention'. The purpose of regulating names is to clarify status distinctions and identify similarities/differences.
process_zh: 明确概念所指的实际对象（实）
审视现有名称是否准确对应
区分'共名'（类概念）与'别名'（个体概念）
对混淆、歧义的名称进行澄清或修正
通过社会共识确立新的规范用法
process_en: Clarify the actual object referred to by concepts
Examine whether existing names accurately correspond
Distinguish 'common names' (class concepts) from 'individual names'
Clarify or correct confusing/ambiguous names
Establish new normative usage through social consensus
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 名无固宜，约之以命，约定俗成谓之宜。（《正名》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Names have no fixed appropriateness; they are designated by convention, and what is agreed upon and made customary is called appropriate.
representative_cases_zh: '三惑'说批判——名实混乱的三种弊病
'后王之成名'的传承与创新——旧名沿用与新名创制
representative_cases_en: Critique of 'Three Confusions'—three types of name-reality confusion
'Former kings' name creation'—continuity and innovation in naming
modern_applications_zh: 沟通障碍的诊断与化解
政策文件与法律文本起草
modern_applications_en: Diagnosis and resolution of communication barriers
Policy document and legal text drafting

thinking_modes.name_en: Accumulate Small to Achieve Great Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 任何成就都来自微小积累的持续叠加。'不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海'。强调持久性、连续性和渐进性，反对一蹴而就的幻想。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Any achievement comes from continuous accumulation of small steps. 'Without accumulating small steps, one cannot reach a thousand li; without accumulating small streams, one cannot form rivers and seas'. Emphasizes persistence, continuity, and gradual progress.
process_zh: 确立明确的长期目标
分解为每日可执行的小步骤
保持持续不间断的努力
定期回顾积累的成果
在量变积累到临界点时捕捉质变
process_en: Establish clear long-term goals
Break down into daily executable small steps
Maintain continuous uninterrupted effort
Regularly review accumulated achievements
Capture qualitative change when quantitative accumulation reaches critical point
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得，圣心备焉。（《劝学》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Accumulate earth to make a mountain, and winds and rains will arise; accumulate water to make an abyss, and dragons will be born; accumulate goodness to become virtue, and divine understanding will be attained.
representative_cases_zh: '螾无爪牙之利'对比'螃蟹六跪而二螯'——专注积微胜过天赋条件
'青出于蓝而胜于蓝'——通过积累后人可超越前人
representative_cases_en: Earthworm vs crab comparison—accumulation beats innate endowment
'Blue comes from indigo but is bluer'—later generations surpass predecessors through accumulation

thinking_modes.name_en: Clarify Divisions to Enable Group Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人之所以能组成社会（'群'），在于有明确的分工与等级（'分'）。'分'由礼义来规定，是消除争夺、实现和谐的基础。明定名分使群体有序运行，是荀子社会理论的核心。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Humans can form societies ('group') because of clear division of labor and hierarchy ('division'). 'Division' is prescribed by ritual-righteousness, forming the foundation for eliminating conflict and achieving harmony.
process_zh: 识别群体的共同目标与协作需求
设计清晰的分工与等级体系
以礼义准则规范各角色的权利与义务
建立协调机制使不同层级和谐运作
定期检视'分'的合理性并适时调整
process_en: Identify group's common goals and collaboration needs
Design clear division of labor and hierarchical system
Regulate each role's rights and obligations by ritual-righteousness
Establish coordination mechanisms for harmonious operation
Regularly examine reasonableness of 'division' and adjust
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人何以能群？曰：分。分何以能行？曰：义。（《王制》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: How can humans form groups? Answer: division. How can division work? Answer: righteousness.
representative_cases_zh: '人能群，彼不能群'——人与动物之别在于社会组织能力
'维齐非齐'的国家治理——差异化分工中各得其所
representative_cases_en: 'Humans can group, others cannot'—difference between humans and animals lies in social organization
'Equality through inequality'—each gets their place in differentiated division

thinking_modes.name_en: Revere Teachers and Value Learning Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 学问与道德不能自学得之，必须依靠老师的教导与经典的指引。'礼者，所以正身也；师者，所以正礼也。无师，吾安知礼之为是也？'尊师是学习的起点，也是传承正统、避免误入歧途的保障。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Learning and morality cannot be acquired through self-study alone; must rely on teachers' guidance and classics' direction. 'Ritual rectifies the person; teachers rectify ritual. Without teachers, how would I know what ritual is?'
process_zh: 识别可靠的老师与经典（'正理'之源）
以谦卑态度向师法学习
在实践中印证所学
在掌握正统基础上发展个人见解
成为老师后传承知识
process_en: Identify reliable teachers and classics (source of 'right principle')
Learn with humble attitude toward teachers and methods
Verify learning through practice
Develop personal insights based on orthodox mastery
Transmit knowledge after becoming a teacher
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 有师法者，人之大宝也；无师法者，人之大殃也。（《儒效》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Having teachers and methods is humanity's greatest treasure; lacking them is humanity's greatest calamity.
representative_cases_zh: '学不可以已'与'青出于蓝'——学习永无止境
'批判'邯郸学步'——不尊师法而模仿他人终将失去自我
representative_cases_en: 'Learning cannot cease' and 'blue surpasses indigo'—learning is endless
Critique of 'Handan walk'—imitating others without proper foundation loses one's own way
modern_applications_zh: 组织知识传承与文化建设
modern_applications_en: Organizational knowledge transmission and culture building
Balance between academic inheritance and innovation

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人皆有趋利避害的自然倾向，这是人性的事实而非缺陷。关键是运用理性对'利'进行权衡与排序——不是否定利，而是以'义'为标准来取舍。'义'是最高价值，但不是凭空设定，而是解决利益冲突的最优方案。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Humans naturally tend toward benefit and avoid harm; this is a fact of human nature, not a defect. The key is to use rationality to weigh and rank 'benefits'—not denying benefit, but using 'righteousness' as the standard for choice.
process_zh: 识别决策中的各项利害因素
运用'权衡'思维比较利弊大小
以'义'（公正原则）为最高准绳取舍
在无法两全时选择'害之中取小'
将决策结果反馈调整未来的行为模式
process_en: Identify all benefit and harm factors in decisions
Use 'weighing' thinking to compare magnitude of benefits and harms
Use 'righteousness' (justice principle) as highest standard
When both cannot be achieved, choose 'lesser harm'
Feed decision results back to adjust future behavior patterns
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 利之中取大，害之中取小也。（《大略》）
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Among benefits, choose the greater; among harms, choose the lesser.
representative_cases_zh: '饥而欲食，寒而欲暖'的人性分析——承认基本欲望但需节制
'利'的层次区分——君子'见利思义'，小人'见利忘义'
representative_cases_en: 'Hungry want to eat, cold want to warm' analysis—acknowledge basic desires but need restraint
Hierarchy of 'benefit'—gentleman 'considers righteousness when seeing benefit'; petty person 'forgets righteousness when seeing benefit'
modern_applications_zh: 资源配置与优先级排序

methodology_summary.core_principle: 性恶立基，化性起伪；礼法兼施，明分使群；虚壹而静，积微成著
thinking_characteristics: 经验主义与理性主义结合
现实主义与人道关怀并重
渐进积累而非一蹴而就
制度设计与道德教化双轨
兼容并包而非门户之见
methodology_summary.philosophical_foundation: 从天道自然到人道建构的务实儒学
methodology_summary.political_vision: 礼法合一、群居和一、尊君尚贤
methodology_summary.academic_contribution: 先秦儒家集大成者，开创名学与认知方法论，影响法家形成

historical_significance.contemporary_impact: 荀学在汉代为官学主流，深刻塑造了中国传统政治文化；清代考据学重新发掘荀子价值；当代新儒家虽有争议但荀子思想越来越受到重视
modern_relevance: 性恶立基法对制度设计的启示——不依赖人性完美假设
虚壹而静法对信息时代认知偏见的警示
积微成著法对长期主义与复利思维的古代印证
礼法兼施法对德法共治的现代回响
明分使群法对组织治理的结构启示
historical_significance.limitations: 等级秩序观念需批判继承；尊师传统需防权威崇拜；性恶预设需防滥用为管制借口

key_sources: 《荀子》（杨倞注，王先谦《荀子集解》）
《性恶》《劝学》《天论》《解蔽》《正名》《礼论》《王制》《富国》
research_notes.scholarly_consensus: 先秦儒家集大成者；性恶论非悲观主义而是制度设计的现实起点；礼法兼施开法家先河；'虚壹而静'为中国古代认知方法论最高峰之一

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 从'人之性恶，其善者伪也'出发，将人性视为未经教化的原始材朴，善并非先天固有而是后天人为建构的结果。这一立场不是悲观主义，而是为道德教化与礼法制度奠定必要性与紧迫性的基础。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人之性恶，其善者伪也
process_zh: 正视人性中的自然欲望与自私倾向
识别若放任自流的潜在冲突与混乱
确立外在规范（礼/法）的必要性与来源
设计教化与约束的双重机制
通过持续训练将规范内化为习惯
representative_cases_zh: 批判孟子性善论
《性恶》篇的系统论证

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 心作为'神明之主'，必须保持'虚'（不以已有知识妨碍新知）、'壹'（专一而不分心）、'静'（不被杂念扰动）的状态，方能达到'大清明'境界，正确认知事物、破除偏见遮蔽。这是荀子核心的认知方法论。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人何以知道？曰：心
process_zh: 保持'虚'：清空先入为主的概念与成见，对新信息开放
保持'壹'：专注核心议题，不被无关因素分散注意力
保持'静'：排除情绪波动与杂念干扰，维持理性冷静
综合观察'兼陈万物'，全面收集信息
以'中悬衡'（公正标准）衡量判断，得出'大清明'的认识
representative_cases_zh: 《解蔽》篇批判诸子百家
'心不使焉'之戒
modern_applications_zh: 避免认知偏见与确认偏差

认识并掌握自然界的客观规律

可持续发展与生态治理

thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 名闻而实喻，名之用也

对混淆、歧义的名称进行澄清或修正
