政策文件与法律文本起草
跨文化交流中的命名规范

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 任何成就都来自微小积累的持续叠加。'不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海'。强调持久性、连续性和渐进性，反对一蹴而就的幻想，是荀子方法论中最具实践指导意义的部分。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉；积善成德，而神明自得，圣心备焉
process_zh: 确立明确的长期目标（'终乎卒岁'）
分解为每日可执行的小步骤
保持持续不间断的努力（'不舍'）
定期回顾积累的成果，增强信心
在量变积累到临界点时捕捉质变
representative_cases_zh: '螾无爪牙之利，筋骨之强，上食埃土，下饮黄泉'对比'螃蟹六跪而二螯'
'青出于蓝而胜于蓝'

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人之所以能组成社会（'群'），在于有明确的分工与等级（'分'）。'分'由礼义来规定，是消除争夺、实现和谐的基础。明定名分使群体有序运行，是荀子社会理论的核心。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 人何以能群？曰：分
process_zh: 识别群体的共同目标与协作需求
设计清晰的分工与等级体系（'分'）
以礼义准则规范各角色的权利与义务
建立协调机制使不同层级和谐运作
定期检视'分'的合理性并适时调整
representative_cases_zh: '人能群，彼不能群'
国家治理中的'维齐非齐'

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 学问与道德不能自学得之，必须依靠老师的教导与经典的指引。'礼者，所以正身也；师者，所以正礼也。无师，吾安知礼之为是也？'尊师是学习的起点，也是传承正统、避免误入歧途的保障。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 礼者，所以正身也；师者，所以正礼也
process_zh: 识别可靠的老师与经典（'正理'之源）
以谦卑态度向师法学习，不妄自尊大
在实践中印证所学，避免死记硬背
在掌握正统基础上发展个人见解
成为老师后传承知识，形成良性循环
representative_cases_zh: '学不可以已'与'青出于蓝'
批判'邯郸学步'
modern_applications_zh: 组织知识传承与文化建设
师徒制与现代教育的结合

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人皆有趋利避害的自然倾向，这是人性的事实而非缺陷。关键是运用理性对'利'进行权衡与排序——不是否定利，而是以'义'为标准来取舍。'义'是最高价值，但不是凭空设定，而是解决利益冲突的最优方案。
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 生，亦我所欲也；义，亦我所欲也
process_zh: 识别决策中的各项利害因素
运用'权衡'思维比较利弊大小
以'义'（公正原则）为最高准绳取舍
在无法两全时选择'害之中取小'
将决策结果反馈调整未来的行为模式
representative_cases_zh: '饥而欲食，寒而欲暖'的人性分析
对'利'的层次区分
modern_applications_zh: 资源配置与优先级排序

summary_zh: 荀子（战国，约前316—前237）先秦儒家集大成者，赵国人，曾三为齐稷下学宫祭酒。提出十大思维模式：性恶立基法、虚壹而静法、化性起伪法、礼法兼施法、天行有常法、制名指实法、积微成著法、明分使群法、尊师重法学、权衡利弊法。
summary_en: Xunzi (Warring States, c. 316-237 BC), synthesizer of early Confucianism, from Zhao state. Proposed 10 thinking modes covering epistemology, ethics, political philosophy, and methodology.

primary_domain: 哲学/本体论/伦理学/政治实践

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以太虚为气的本然状态，否定佛道以空、无以为本体的观点。太虚无形，气之本体；其聚其散，变化之客形尔。宇宙间不存在绝对的'无'或'空'，一切存在都是气的不同形态——聚则为万物，散则归太虚。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Taking Tai Xu (Great Void) as the original state of Qi, rejecting Buddhist and Daoist views that take emptiness/nothingness as ontology. Tai Xu is formless, the original substance of Qi; its aggregation and dispersion are transient forms.
process_zh: 否定绝对虚无的存在——'知太虚即气，则无无'
确立气为宇宙唯一实体
解释万物生灭为气的聚散变化
构建循环本体论框架
process_en: Negate absolute nothingness
Establish Qi as the sole cosmic substance
Explain birth and death as aggregation/dispersion of Qi
Construct cyclic ontology framework
modern_applications_zh: 系统思维中的整体性原理
物质守恒与能量转换思考

thinking_modes.name_en: One Thing Two Bodies Method (Dialectical Unity)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 任何事物内部都包含对立面（阴阳），'有两亦一在，无两亦一在'。矛盾不是外在冲突而是内在统一的基础，对立面相互依存、相互转化，构成了事物运动变化的根本动力。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Every thing contains opposing forces (Yin-Yang) within—it has two and one, without two there is still one. Contradiction is not external conflict but the foundation of internal unity.
process_zh: 识别事物内部的对立统一结构
分析对立面的相互依存关系
理解矛盾双方转化的条件与机制
在对立统一中把握事物的运动规律
process_en: Identify the dialectical structure within any thing
Analyze how opposites interdepend on each other
Understand conditions and mechanisms of contradictory transformation

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '大其心则能体天下之物'，超越感官闻见的有限性，以无限之心体认万物。世人之心止于见闻之狭，圣人尽性不以见闻梏其心。通过扩展心的边界，达到'视天下无一物非我'的境界。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Expand the great mind and you can comprehend all things under heaven.' Transcend the limited nature of sensory perception; the sage fully actualizes nature without being confined by seeing and hearing.
process_zh: 识别感官闻见的局限性
超越经验认知的边界限制
通过尽性修养扩大心的体认范围
达到'视天下无一物非我'的万物一体境界
process_en: Recognize the limitations of sensory perception
Transcend boundaries of empirical cognition
Expand mind's comprehension through nature-actualizing cultivation
modern_applications_zh: 超越经验主义认知框架

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 通过'知礼'达到'成性'，以礼仪规范为途径塑造和完善人的道德本性。知礼不是外在约束而是内在修养的方法，通过学习和践行礼仪规范来变化气质、成就圣人品格。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Know ritual to form character'—using ritual norms as the path to shape and perfect moral nature. Knowing ritual is not external constraint but inner cultivation method.
process_zh: 学习礼仪规范的内容与精神
将外在礼制内化为道德自觉
通过持续践行改变先天气质
最终成就圣人的完整人格
process_en: Study the content and spirit of ritual norms
Internalize external rituals as moral consciousness
Transform innate temperament through continuous practice
modern_applications_zh: 礼仪教育的人格塑造功能

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 人人皆有天地之性（善的本源），但受气质所拘而有善恶之分。通过修养工夫可以'变化气质'，恢复天地之性的本然状态。这是张载人性论的核心：既肯定人人可为圣人的可能性，又强调后天修养的必要性。
thinking_modes.definition_en: All people possess Heavenly Nature (the origin of goodness), but are constrained by temperament, leading to good/evil distinctions. Through cultivation practice, one can 'transform temperament' and restore the original state of Heavenly Nature.
process_zh: 认识自身气质之偏与局限
通过读书明理纠正偏差
以礼制约束日常行为
逐步改变气质恢复天地之性
process_en: Recognize one's own temperament biases and limitations
Correct deviations through reading and understanding principles
modern_applications_zh: 教育中的因材施教原理

thinking_modes.name_en: Universal Brotherhood Method (All People Are My Brethren)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '民吾同胞，物吾与也'——天下苍生都是我的手足同胞，天地万物都与我有亲缘关系。将仁爱从血缘扩展到全社会乃至整个自然界，构建了最广泛的伦理关怀体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'All people are my brothers, all things are my companions'—all beings under heaven are my siblings, and all things in the cosmos share kinship with me. Expanding benevolence from blood ties to all society and even the natural world.
process_zh: 确立天为父、坤为母的宇宙家庭观
将所有人视为同胞手足
关怀弱势群体（老、幼、孤、寡、残疾）
将伦理关怀扩展到天地万物
process_en: Establish cosmic family view: Heaven as Father, Earth as Mother
View all people as siblings and fellow beings
modern_applications_zh: 普世人权理念的中国表达

thinking_modes.name_en: Four Sentences of Hengqu Method (Cosmic Responsibility Framework)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平'——通过四个'为'字将个人修养与宇宙关怀、历史使命和未来理想融为一体。每个'为'都是主动的担当，而非被动的承受；每个人都可以成为历史的主体。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Establish heart for Heaven and Earth, establish destiny for the people, continue lost teachings of past sages, open peace for ten thousand generations'—four 'establishing' verbs integrate personal cultivation with cosmic concern, historical mission and future ideal.
process_zh: 为天地立心：建立以仁为核心的价值体系
为生民立命：让百姓安身立命、精神有依归
为往圣继绝学：继承发扬儒学传统
为万世开太平：实现理想社会秩序
process_en: Establish heart for Heaven and Earth
Establish destiny for people
Continue lost teachings of past sages
modern_applications_zh: 知识分子的使命意识建构

thinking_modes.name_en: Critique of Buddhism and Daoism Method
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 站在儒学立场上，从宇宙本体论高度批判佛道二教。指出佛家以'空'为本体、道家以'无'为根源都是错误的，建立了气一元论的替代方案。同时吸收佛道思辨方法，将其纳入儒学体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Standing on Confucian ground, critiquing Buddhism and Daoism from the level of cosmic ontology. Pointing out that Buddhist 'emptiness' and Daoist 'nothingness' as origins are wrong, while building Qi monism alternative.
process_zh: 识别佛道本体论的根本错误
从体用关系角度批判'空''无'概念
建立气一元论的替代宇宙观
吸收佛道思辨方法丰富儒学
process_en: Identify fundamental errors in Buddhist and Daoist ontology
Critique 'emptiness' and 'nothingness' concepts through substance-function relations
modern_applications_zh: 文化批判与重建方法论
跨思想体系的批判性吸收

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '论治人先务，未始不以经界为急'——晚年回到横渠，买地实践《周礼》井田制，划分土地、疏通水渠。将抽象的儒家经济理想转化为具体的制度试验，在关中多地实施井田制改革实验。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'In governing people, nothing comes first—always prioritize land boundary regulation'—in old age returned to Hengqu, bought land to practice the Zhou Dynasty's well-field system, dividing land and clearing irrigation channels.
process_zh: 将儒家经济理想具体化为可操作的制度设计
选择横渠作为试验基地
实际划分土地、疏通水渠
观察效果并反思完善
process_en: Translate Confucian economic ideals into operable institutional designs
Select Hengqu as experimental base
modern_applications_zh: 政策试点与制度创新的系统方法
理想政策的落地路径设计

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 创建'关学'学派，通过讲学、著书、培养弟子实现学术传承。从少年习兵到中年弃武从文，从广读佛道到回归儒学，张载完成了学术路线的完整转型，最终在横渠书院创立了影响关中八百年之久的学派体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Creating the 'Guan School' through teaching, writing, and cultivating disciples to achieve academic transmission. From youth studying military to middle age abandoning arms for texts, Zhang Zai completed a full academic transformation.
process_zh: 确立独特的学术方向和理论体系
创建横渠书院作为教学基地
培养弟子传承关学精神
通过著作确立学派经典
process_en: Establish unique academic direction and theoretical system
Create Hengqu Academy as teaching base
modern_applications_zh: 学术学派的建设方法论
思想传承的制度化路径

summary_zh: 张载（1020—1077），字子厚，号横渠，世称横渠先生。北宋关学创始人，宋明理学奠基人之一。提出十大思维模式：太虚即气法（宇宙本体论）、一物两体法（辩证统一思维）、大心体物法（超越闻见的认识论）、知礼成性法（道德修养工夫）、变化气质法（人性改造方法）、民胞物与法（普遍伦理学）、横渠四句法（经世致用理想论）、批判佛道法（儒学正统重建）、井田实践法（制度变革试验）、关学建构法（学派传承体系）。横渠四句千古传颂，'为天地立心，为生民立命，为往圣继绝学，为万世开太平'。
summary_en: Zhang Zai (1020—1077), courtesy name Zihou, pseudonym Hengqu. Founder of Guan School during Northern Song and one of the founding figures of Neo-Confucianism. Proposed 10 thinking modes covering ontology (Tai Xu is Qi), dialectics (One Thing Two Bodies), epistemology (Great Mind Comprehension), ethics (Ritual-Knowing Character Formation, Transforming Temperament, Universal Brotherhood), political practice (Four Sentines of Hengqu, Well-Field Practice), and academic construction (Guan School Building). His Four Sentences have been celebrated through the ages.

intellectual_tradition: 兵家学派/春秋军事思想
description_zh: 孙子（名武，字长卿），春秋末期齐国人，后活跃于吴国，中国古代最伟大的军事家、战略思想家，《孙子兵法》作者。其思想体系以'全胜'为核心，强调'不战而屈人之兵'的战略最高境界，通过'五事七计'进行系统性战略评估，运用'奇正''虚实''势''变'等辩证范畴构建了一套完整的战争指导理论。孙子被誉为'兵圣'，其思想超越军事领域，深刻影响中国政治、经济、外交及现代商业竞争理论。
description_en: Sun Tzu (Wu, courtesy name Changqing), a military strategist and philosopher from the late Spring and Autumn period, originally from the State of Qi who served the State of Wu. Author of 'The Art of War' (Sunzi Bingfa), he is the greatest military thinker in ancient China. His thought system centers on 'complete victory' (Quan Sheng), emphasizing 'subduing the enemy without fighting' as the highest strategic ideal. Through systematic evaluation via the 'Five Constants and Seven Calculations', and dialectical categories of 'unorthodox/orthodox' (Qi-Zheng), 'void/solid' (Xu-Shi), 'momentum' (Shi), and 'change' (Bian), he constructed a complete theory of war guidance. Known as the 'Military Sage', his thought transcends military domains and profoundly influences Chinese politics, economics, diplomacy, and modern business competition theory.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M634(全胜思维), M635(先胜后战), M636(知彼知己), M637(奇正相生), M638(避实击虚), M639(因敌变化), M640(慎战思维), M641(造势借势), M642(速胜思维), M643(用间信息)。孙子思维体系以'全胜-先胜-知彼-奇正-虚实-因变-慎战-造势-速胜-用间'十维一体为特色，构成中国古代最完整的战争指导理论体系。五大独特特征：战略至上性（以最小代价获取最大胜利）、系统预判性（五事七计的系统评估）、辩证灵动性（奇正虚实的变化运用）、信息主导性（用间为先的情报意识）、全局谨慎性（慎战为国之大事）。三大创新突破：兵学鼻祖开创完整战争理论体系、将战争从经验上升为科学、思想超越军事领域成为跨学科智慧。他是Protreptic中唯一将'全胜-先胜-知彼'三位一体构建的战略思想家。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M634(Complete Victory), M635(Preemptive Victory), M636(Know Yourself and Enemy), M637(Unorthodox-Orthodox Synergy), M638(Void-Solid Exploitation), M639(Adaptation to Enemy), M640(Prudent Warfare), M641(Momentum Creation), M642(Rapid Victory), M643(Intelligence via Spies). Sun Tzu's thinking system features ten-dimensional integration of 'Complete-Preemptive-Know-Change-Prudent-Momentum-Speed-Intelligence', forming the most complete ancient Chinese war guidance theory. Five unique characteristics: strategic supremacy, systematic pre-judgment, dialectical flexibility, information dominance, global prudence. Three breakthroughs: founding father of military science, elevating war from experience to system, transdisciplinary wisdom. He is the only strategic thinker in Protreptic who systematically integrates 'Complete Victory-Preemptive Strike-Know Enemy' into a trinity framework.

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 追求以最小代价获取最大胜利，最高境界是'不战而屈人之兵'。通过谋略、外交、威慑等综合手段使敌人屈服，而非依赖单纯军事对抗。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Pursuing maximum victory with minimum cost; the highest realm is 'subduing the enemy without fighting'. Through strategy, diplomacy, deterrence and other comprehensive means, force the enemy to submit rather than relying solely on military confrontation.
process_zh: 评估达成目标的多种路径（谋略/外交/军事）
优先选择非军事手段解决冲突
若必须作战，寻求最低代价的最优方案
追求全胜而非仅求战胜

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '胜兵先胜而后求战，败兵先战而后求胜'。先通过充分准备建立必胜态势，再寻求战机出战；而非先开战局再侥幸求胜。核心在于'先为不可胜，以待敌之可胜'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Victorious warriors win first and then go to war, while defeated warriors go to war first and then seek to win.' Build an invincible position through thorough preparation, then seek the opportunity.
process_zh: 识别并消除自身的脆弱点
通过'五事七计'全面评估胜算
积累足以压倒对手的资源和优势
等待并捕捉敌人的失误时机
在优势确立后再发动行动

thinking_modes.name_en: Self-and-Enemy Knowledge Method (Zhi Bi Zhi Ji)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '知彼知己，百战不殆'。全面了解敌我双方实力、意图、态势，是决策的基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Know yourself and know your enemy, and you can fight a hundred battles without disaster.' Comprehensive understanding of both sides is the foundation of decision-making.
process_zh: 系统收集敌方信息（情报/数据/行为模式）
客观评估自身实力和局限
对比分析双方的优势劣势
基于全面信息制定策略
持续更新认知以应对变化

thinking_modes.name_en: Unorthodox-Orthodox Synergy Method (Qi Zheng Xiang Sheng)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '凡战者，以正合，以奇胜'。正代表常规、正面、规范的方法；奇代表非常规、侧翼、出人意料的创新。奇正相生，循环无穷。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'In battle, use the direct to engage, and the indirect to win.' Zheng represents conventional methods, Qi represents unconventional innovations. They generate each other infinitely.
process_zh: 以正面对抗牵制对手
寻找并 exploitation 对手的盲区和弱点
奇正转换，使对手无法预判
在关键节点集中奇兵创造决定性优势

thinking_modes.name_en: Void-Solid Exploitation Method (Bi Shi Ji Xu)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '避实而击虚'——避开敌人的坚实之处，攻击其虚弱环节。'致人而不致于人'——主动调动敌人暴露弱点。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Avoid what is strong, strike what is weak.' Actively manipulate the enemy to expose vulnerabilities while avoiding their strengths.
process_zh: 识别敌人的实力和弱点分布
避免在敌人最强点正面交锋
通过调动和伪装使敌人暴露弱点
集中力量攻击最脆弱的环节
持续转换虚实态势

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '兵形象水，水因地而制流，兵因敌而制胜'。用兵没有固定模式，要根据敌人变化灵活调整。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Military tactics are like water; water shapes its course according to the ground, and the soldier shapes his victory according to the enemy.' No fixed pattern in war.
process_zh: 观察和判断敌人的实时状态
打破固有思维和预设方案
根据战场变化灵活调整策略
在变化中寻找新的机会点
保持策略的不可预测性

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '兵者，国之大事，死生之地，存亡之道，不可不察也'。战争关乎生死存亡，必须极度谨慎，不因情绪冲动决策。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'War is a matter of vital importance to the state, a matter of life and death. It must be carefully examined.' Never decide from emotion.
process_zh: 评估战争的必要性（是否别无选择）
估算战争的成本与风险
权衡战与不战的利弊
只有在符合利益时才行动
保持理性，不受情绪左右

thinking_modes.name_en: Momentum Creation Method (Zao Shi Jie Shi)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '善战者，求之于势，不责于人'。通过营造有利的态势和氛围，使胜利成为必然。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'The clever combatant looks to the effect of momentum, not to the integrity of individual soldiers.' Create favorable conditions so victory becomes inevitable.
process_zh: 识别和营造有利的客观条件
通过部署和准备形成压倒性态势
选择合适的时机和地点释放势能
利用态势而非依赖个人能力
使胜利成为势能的自然结果

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '兵闻拙速，未睹巧之久也。夫兵久而国利者，未之有也'。战争宜速不宜久，持久消耗国力损害民生。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'I have heard of clumsy haste, but never of skillful procrastination.' Speed is preferred over prolonged engagement; prolonged war has never benefited a state.
process_zh: 评估快速解决的可行性
集中资源在关键点实现突破
避免陷入持久消耗的陷阱
在窗口期内完成目标
速战速决以降低综合成本

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '先知者，不可取于鬼神，不可象于事，不可验于度，必取于人'。情报是决策基础，必须通过人的渠道获取真实信息。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'He who wants to win must know the enemy's situation beforehand. This cannot be obtained from spirits, must be obtained from people who know the enemy.' Intelligence is the foundation of decision-making.
process_zh: 建立多渠道情报收集体系
投入资源获取关键信息（'莫先于用间'）
通过反间获取敌方内部信息
甄别和验证情报真实性
将情报转化为决策优势

summary_zh: 孙子（春秋末期）是中国兵学奠基人，其《孙子兵法》是世界上最早的军事理论著作。孙子的思维体系以'全胜'为最高追求，以'先胜后战'为基本方法，以'知彼知己'为前提，以'奇正''虚实''势''变'为战术核心。十个核心思维模式构成有机整体。孙子思维具有五大独特特征：战略至上性、系统预判性、辩证灵动性、信息主导性、全局谨慎性。三大创新突破：创建完整战争理论体系、从经验升华为科学、超越军事成为跨学科智慧。他是Protreptic中唯一将'全胜-先胜-知彼'三位一体构建的战略思想家。
summary_en: Sun Tzu (late Spring and Autumn period) is the founder of Chinese military science. His 'Art of War' is the world's earliest military theory treatise. His thinking system pursues 'Complete Victory' as the highest ideal, uses 'Preemptive Victory' as the basic method, takes 'Know Yourself and Enemy' as the prerequisite, and employs 'Unorthodox-Orthodox', 'Void-Solid', 'Momentum', and 'Change' as tactical cores. Ten core thinking modes form an organic whole. Five unique characteristics: strategic supremacy, systematic pre-judgment, dialectical flexibility, information dominance, global prudence. Three breakthroughs: creating a complete war theory system, elevating experience to science, transcending military to become transdisciplinary wisdom. He is the only strategic thinker in Protreptic who systematically integrates 'Complete Victory-Preemptive Strike-Know Enemy' into a trinity framework.

name_zh: 战略预判法/天命预判法
definition_zh: 通过观察'民变阈值→官逼民反→天命转移'三阶段信号，预判政权合法性危机的临界点，提前布局政治选择。候选人把战略预判用于'历史周期的政权更替预判'——其对象不是现代经济或政治路线，而是'天命转移'的宏观历史趋势。
definition_en: By observing three-stage signals of 'civil unrest threshold → official oppression provoking rebellion → Mandate transfer,' forecasting the critical point of regime legitimacy crisis and making early political positioning. The Candidate applies strategic prediction specifically to 'dynastic cycle regime succession forecasting' — targeting not modern economics or political platforms, but the macro-historical trend of 'Mandate transfer.'
process_zh: 观测天象民心——记录灾异祥瑞、民间舆论、流民数量等社会信号
判断民变阈值——评估民众忍耐限度是否接近临界点
识别官逼民反——追踪政府失道与民变爆发的因果关系
预判天命转移——综合判断政权合法性是否正在丧失
提前政治布局——在天命转移窗口期做出站队或改革决策
representative_cases_zh: 刘邦
朱元璋
陈胜吴广
modern_applications_zh: 企业转型期决策时机把握
行业颠覆时间窗口预判

name_zh: 边际思维法/制度变革边际计算法
name_en: Marginal Thinking Method (Institutional Reform Marginal Calculation)
definition_zh: 精确计算每一次制度变革的'边际增量收益 vs 边际政治成本'，以边际收益>边际成本的铁律决定改革力度，避免激进改革引发的系统性崩溃。
definition_en: Precisely calculating the 'marginal incremental benefit vs political cost' of each institutional reform, using the iron law of marginal benefit > marginal cost to determine reform intensity, avoiding systemic collapse triggered by radical reform.
process_zh: 识别改革变量——确定制度改革涉及的核心参数
测算边际收益——评估每增加一个改革变量的预期收益
估算边际成本——评估每增加一个改革变量的政治阻力
计算边际均衡点——找到边际收益=边际成本的最优改革力度
渐进推进改革——每次改革控制在边际均衡点以内
representative_cases_zh: 王安石
张居正
商鞅
modern_applications_zh: 企业组织变革力度控制
政策试点推广风险控制
教育改革招生规模边际计算

name_zh: 自然选择法/政治人才制度化筛选法
name_en: Natural Selection Method (Institutionalized Political Talent Screening)
definition_zh: 构建多层级人才筛选机制，从初筛（察举）到再筛（科举）到终筛（殿试），每层设置高淘汰率，以'适者生存'的制度性竞争实现政治精英的代际更新。
definition_en: Building multi-tier talent screening mechanisms from initial screening (recommendation) to re-screening (examination) to final screening (palace exam), setting high elimination rates at each tier, achieving political elite generational renewal through institutionalized 'survival of the fittest' competition.
source_chapter: 《科举史》《中国人才选拔制度史》
process_zh: 设计多层筛选关卡——设置察举→科举→殿试三级淘汰机制
设定高淘汰率标准——每层淘汰率控制在90%以上
构建竞争生态——以高强度竞争压力筛选最优者
建立代际更新机制——定期大规模人才替换保持系统活力
反馈淘汰结果——失败者进入下一循环形成持续竞争压力
representative_cases_zh: 唐太宗
武则天
宋代士大夫
modern_applications_zh: 组织优胜劣汰机制设计

name_zh: 制度化制衡法/选任察黜四环节制衡法
definition_zh: 不把希望寄托于'明君贤臣'的个人品德，而是设计'选、任、察、黜'四环节的制度自动纠错机制——让权力在制衡中运行，让错误在程序中暴露。
definition_en: Not placing hope in the personal virtue of 'wise rulers and capable ministers,' but designing a four-stage institutional error-correction mechanism of 'selection, appointment, inspection, removal' — letting power operate within checks, letting errors surface through procedures.
process_zh: 设计四环节制衡架构——选（选拔）→任（任命）→察（考察）→黜（罢黜）
设置相互监督机制——每个环节由不同主体负责形成权力分散
建立程序自动纠错——不依赖个人品德依赖程序暴露错误
实现权力循环流动——定期考核不合格者自动退出
保持制度弹性——根据朝代特点调整各环节权重
representative_cases_zh: 汉武帝
唐太宗
宋代台谏
modern_applications_zh: 企业董事会-管理层-监事会三分立
项目审批流程多环节制衡

name_zh: 信息高速法/政治信息高频传递法
name_en: Information Highway Method (High-Frequency Political Information Transmission)
definition_zh: 把'信息流速'视为政治选择的'生命线'，构建从郡县到中央的高速信息通道——从'察举'的地方推荐到'科举'的中央统一考试，从'密折制度'的直达天听到'题本通政司'的层层上传，信息流速决定了政治选择的精准度与响应速度。
definition_en: Treating 'information velocity' as the 'lifeline' of political selection, constructing high-speed information corridors from counties to capital — from local recommendation of 'Cha Ju' to centralized examination of 'Keju,' from direct-to-emperor secret memorials to layered transmission via Memorial Office, where information velocity determines political selection precision and response speed.
process_zh: 设计信息传递网络——建立从地方到中央的驿站/递铺系统
加密信息传递频率——从日行五百里到日行七百里提升信息流速
建立直达通道——密折制度使信息不经中间环节直达最高层
实施信息反馈机制——中央指令通过同一网络快速下达地方
保持信息准确性——通过多级传递验证信息真伪
representative_cases_zh: 清代军机处
唐代驿传
宋代急递铺
modern_applications_zh: 企业基层到决策层信息快速传递
紧急事件直达指挥中心

school: 道家哲学/齐物论/逍遥游/相对主义认识论

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 核心思维模式：M21(无为而治法)、M24(虚实转化法)、M30(认知偏差识别法)、M43(齐物相对法)、M44(寓言叙事法)。庄子的独特贡献在于：他是中国历史上第一个系统性使用'寓言思辨'作为哲学方法的思想家；他将相对主义从认识论工具提升为存在论革命（齐物）；他提出了'无待'这一超越所有条件依赖的自由理想；他开创了'物化'观念，消解主体与客体的本质界限。这些思维模式在现有78种模式中，M21已部分覆盖其顺应自然的一面，但庄子的贡献远超此范畴——他发展出了'认知解构'（M43）、'叙事认识论'（M44）、'主客消融'（M24）三个全新维度，构成中国思想史上独一无二的'诗性理性'传统。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Core thinking modes: M21(Cushlessness Governance), M24虚实转化(Reality-Illusion Transformation), M30(Cognitive Bias Recognition), M43 Qiwu Relativism (Equality of Things), M44 Fable Narrative Method. Zhuangzi's unique contribution: he was the first systematic user of 'fable-based thinking' as a philosophical method in Chinese history; he elevated relativism from epistemological tool to ontological revolution (Qiwu); he proposed 'wu dai' as a freedom ideal transcending all conditional dependence; he created the 'transformation of things' concept, dissolving the essential boundary between subject and object. In the existing 78 modes, M21 partially covers his 'following nature' aspect, but Zhuangzi's contribution far exceeds this — he developed three new dimensions: 'cognitive deconstruction' (M43), 'narrative epistemology' (M44), 'subject-object消融' (M24), forming a uniquely Chinese 'poetic rationality' tradition.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《庄子》内七篇（逍遥游、齐物论、养生主、大宗师、人间世、德充符、应帝王）
process: Step 1: 齐物解构——用「齐物相对法」(M43)识别一切对立范畴（是非、彼此、大小、生死）的人为建构性，通过'莫若以明'打破二元对立框架
Step 2: 破除成心——用「认知偏差识别法」(M30)觉察'成心'（prejudgment）如何遮蔽真实认知，以'吾丧我'实现认知主体的自我消解
Step 3: 虚实转化——用「虚实转化法」(M24)在'有待'与'无待'之间建立动态平衡，不执着于任何一方，如'庄周梦蝶'所示
Step 4: 寓言叙事——用「寓言叙事法」(M44)将抽象哲理转化为可体验的故事（鲲鹏、庖丁、濠梁、轮扁斫轮等），实现'得意忘言'
Step 5: 逍遥体证——用「无为而治法」(M21)的实践路径：无己→无功→无名，最终达到'乘天地之正，御六气之辩，以游无穷'的境界

Step 4: 寓言叙事——用「寓言叙事法」(M44)将抽象哲理转化为可体验的故事（鲲鹏、庖丁、濠梁、轮扁斫轮等），实现'得意忘言'
Step 5: 逍遥体证——用「无为而治法」(M21)的实践路径：无己→无功→无名，最终达到'乘天地之正，御六气之辩，以游无穷'的境界

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 核心思维模式：M21(无为而治法)、M24(虚实转化法)、M30(认知偏差识别法)、M43(齐物相对法)、M44(寓言叙事法)。庄子的独特贡献在于：他是中国历史上第一个系统性使用'寓言思辨'作为哲学方法的思想家；他将相对主义从认识论工具提升为存在论革命（齐物）；他提出了'无待'这一超越所有条件依赖的自由理想；他开创了'物化'观念，消解主体与客体的本质界限。这些思维模式在现有78种模式中，M21已部分覆盖其顺应自然的一面，但庄子的贡献远超此范畴——他发展出了'认知解构'（M43）、'叙事认识论'（M44）、'主客消融'（M24）三个全新维度，构成中国思想史上独一无二的'诗性理性'传统。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Core thinking modes: M21(Cushlessness Governance), M24虚实转化(Reality-Illusion Transformation), M30(Cognitive Bias Recognition), M43 Qiwu Relativism (Equality of Things), M44 Fable Narrative Method. Zhuangzi's unique contribution: he was the first systematic user of 'fable-based thinking' as a philosophical method in Chinese history; he elevated relativism from epistemological tool to ontological revolution (Qiwu); he proposed 'wu dai' as a freedom ideal transcending all conditional dependence; he created the 'transformation of things' concept, dissolving the essential boundary between subject and object. In the existing 78 modes, M21 partially covers his 'following nature' aspect, but Zhuangzi's contribution far exceeds this — he developed three new dimensions: 'cognitive deconstruction' (M43), 'narrative epistemology' (M44), 'subject-object消融' (M24), forming a uniquely Chinese 'poetic rationality' tradition.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《庄子》内七篇（逍遥游、齐物论、养生主、大宗师、人间世、德充符、应帝王）
process: Step 1: 齐物解构——用「齐物相对法」(M43)识别一切对立范畴（是非、彼此、大小、生死）的人为建构性，通过'莫若以明'打破二元对立框架
Step 2: 破除成心——用「认知偏差识别法」(M30)觉察'成心'（prejudgment）如何遮蔽真实认知，以'吾丧我'实现认知主体的自我消解
Step 3: 虚实转化——用「虚实转化法」(M24)在'有待'与'无待'之间建立动态平衡，不执着于任何一方，如'庄周梦蝶'所示
Step 4: 寓言叙事——用「寓言叙事法」(M44)将抽象哲理转化为可体验的故事（鲲鹏、庖丁、濠梁、轮扁斫轮等），实现'得意忘言'
Step 5: 逍遥体证——用「无为而治法」(M21)的实践路径：无己→无功→无名，最终达到'乘天地之正，御六气之辩，以游无穷'的境界

school: 儒家学派/思孟学派先驱
primary_domain: 伦理学/心性论/孝道哲学
representative_works: 《大学》（四书之一，修齐治平纲领）
《孝经》（中国第一部系统阐述孝道的专论）
historical_significance: 曾子（约前505-前436年），名参，字子舆，鲁国南武城人（今山东平邑），孔子晚期弟子中最为杰出的思想传承者之一。他以孝道和慎独著称，是儒家内圣外王工夫论的重要奠基人。《大学》传为曾子所作，系统提出'格物、致知、诚意、正心、修身、齐家、治国、平天下'的八目工夫次第，构成了儒家修己治人的完整实践路径。《孝经》是中国历史上第一部系统论述孝道的专著，将孝从家庭伦理提升为普遍的政治道德原则。他曾子一系通过弟子曾申、孔伋（子思）传至孟子，形成'思孟学派'的道统谱系，对宋明理学（尤其是朱熹将《大学》列入四书）影响极为深远。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '君子必慎其独也'——在无人监督的独处状态下依然保持道德自觉，不欺暗室。慎独是儒家工夫论的核心方法之一：将外在的道德规范内化为内在的自我要求，在独处时比在人前更加谨慎自律。这种自我监控机制突破了外在约束的局限，实现了道德主体性的完全确立。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'The gentleman must be watchful over himself when alone' — maintaining moral awareness and self-discipline even in solitude without external supervision. Shen-du is a core Confucian practice: internalizing external moral norms into self-demands, being more vigilant when alone than in company. This self-monitoring mechanism transcends external constraints and establishes complete moral subjectivity.
process: 培养独处时的自我觉察能力
在无人监督时检查内心念头的纯正性
将外在规范完全内化为自我要求
在独处中保持甚至加强道德自律

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '古之欲明明德于天下者，先治其国；欲治其国者，先齐其家；欲齐其家者，先修其身……'《大学》提出的八目工夫论——格物、致知、诚意、正心、修身、齐家、治国、平天下，构成由内而外、由个体到天下的完整实践链条。这是儒家'内圣外王'思想的系统化表达，也是中国古代最著名的政治-伦理实践方法论。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Ancient rulers who wished to illustrate illustrious virtue throughout the world first regulated their states...' The Eight Steps — investigating things, extending knowledge, sincere will, rectifying the mind, cultivating oneself, regulating the family, governing the state, bringing peace to the world — form a complete practical chain from inner self to universal order. This is the systematic expression of Confucian 'inner sage, outer king' philosophy and ancient China's most renowned political-ethical practice methodology.
process: 格物：探究事物原理以获得真知
致知：扩展认知至全面理解
诚意：使意念真诚不欺
正心：端正内心不受情绪干扰
修身：完善个人品德修养
齐家：管理好家庭家族
治国：治理国家社会
平天下：实现天下太平

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '夫孝，德之本也，教之所由生也'。《孝经》将孝从家庭伦理提升为一切道德的根本和起点，认为所有其他德目（忠、义、礼等）皆由孝道衍生。孝不仅是事奉父母的行为规范，更是贯通天人、连接个体与宇宙秩序的本体论原则。这一思想将家庭伦理扩展为政治哲学，使'孝'成为中国古代社会最核心的价值体系。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Filial piety is the root of virtue and from which instruction arises.' The Classic of Filial Piety elevates filial piety from family ethics to the foundation and origin of all moral values, arguing that all other virtues (loyalty, righteousness, propriety) derive from filial piety. Filial piety is not merely behavioral norms for serving parents, but an ontological principle connecting heaven and humanity, the individual and cosmic order. This thought extends family ethics into political philosophy.
process: 认识孝道是一切德行的根本来源
将孝敬父母的情感推广至对师长、社会的责任
在政治领域中实现'移孝作忠'
以孝道为基点构建完整的道德秩序

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '吾道一以贯之'——曾子将孔子的思想概括为'忠恕而已矣'。忠是尽己之心以待人，恕是推己及人以容人，二者构成儒家伦理实践的一贯之道。忠侧重于内在的真诚无欺（正己），恕侧重于外在的推己及人（达人），二者一体两面，不可分割。这一方法论为理解孔子思想体系提供了最简洁的钥匙。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'My way is passed on with one thread' — Zengzi summarized Confucius's teaching as 'loyalty and reciprocity.' Zhong (忠) means serving others with complete sincerity; Shu (恕) means extending oneself to understand and accommodate others. Together they form the consistent way of Confucian ethical practice. Zhong focuses on inner sincerity (correcting oneself), Shu focuses on outward extension (reaching others). They are two sides of one body.
process: 以忠道尽己之心，做到真诚无欺
以恕道推己及人，理解包容他人
在忠与恕的辩证统一中把握儒家核心精神
将一贯之道贯彻于一切伦理实践中

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '日三省吾身：为人谋而不忠乎？与朋友交而不信乎？传不习乎？'曾子创立了系统的自我反思方法，通过每日多次反省自身行为与心念的纯正性，及时发现并纠正偏差。这种持续的内省实践是儒家修身工夫的核心机制，将道德修养从偶然的顿悟转化为日常的习惯性训练。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Each day I examine myself on three counts: in planning for others, was I not faithful? In intercourse with friends, was I not trustworthy? Was what I passed on to others not practiced by me?' Zengzi established a systematic self-reflection method, continuously examining one's thoughts and actions for purity to detect and correct deviations. This sustained introspective practice is the core mechanism of Confucian self-cultivation.
process: 建立日常自省的习惯和框架
从忠（对人）、信（交友）、习（学问）三个维度检视自身
发现偏差后及时纠正并调整行为
通过持续自省实现道德境界的阶梯式提升

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远。仁以为己任，不亦重乎？死而后已，不亦远乎？'曾子将士人的道德担当提升到极致：以推行仁道为终身使命，即使生命终结也不停止。这种将个人命运与天下大道紧密结合的担当精神，成为后世知识分子（士大夫）的精神支柱和身份认同基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'A scholar cannot be without breadth of mind and vigorous endurance — his burden is heavy and his course long. Making humaneness his burden — is it not heavy? Only after death does he cease — is it not long?' Zengzi elevated the scholar's moral responsibility to its utmost: making the promotion of Ren (humaneness) his lifelong mission, ceasing not even at death. This identification of personal destiny with universal Dao became the spiritual pillar for later Chinese intellectuals.
process: 确立以天下道义为个人使命的宏大志向
认识责任的重大和道路的长远
在困境中坚持道义担当不后退
将个人价值与社会责任融为一体
modern_applications: 公共知识分子角色定位

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '启予足，启予手。《诗》云：'战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。''曾子在临终之际检查自己的身体发肤是否完好无损（'身体发肤，受之父母，不敢毁伤'），以此作为一生恪守孝道的最终验证。这种将生命最后一刻的道德完整性视为最高价值的态度，体现了儒家对道德完整性和人格尊严的极致追求。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'Open my feet, open my hands.' The Book of Poetry says: 'Trembling and fearful, as if standing by a deep abyss, as if walking on thin ice.' At deathbed, Zengzi examined whether his body was intact — as filial piety teaches 'body, hair and skin are received from parents and dare not be harmed' — using this as the final verification of a life devoted to filial piety. This attitude treats moral completeness at death as the highest value.
process: 将生命全程视为对道德责任的践行
在生命的每个阶段保持谨慎敬畏的态度
以最终的道德完整性为人生画上句号
将'不敢毁伤'扩展为对一切道德承诺的坚守

thinking_modes.name_en: Inner Sage Outer King Integration Method (Nei-Sheng-Wai-Wang)
thinking_modes.definition_zh: '可以托六尺之孤，可以寄百里之命，临大节而不可夺也'——曾子认为真正的君子应当在一切重大关头保持不可动摇的道德定力。他将内在修养（内圣）与外在事功（外王）贯通为一，认为只有通过内在的诚意正心，才能实现外在的治国平天下。这一思想成为后世儒家政治哲学的核心范式，也是思孟学派道统论的理论基础。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'One who can be entrusted with the orphan of a young state, whose authority can be trusted in governing a hundred li — when facing great crises, his character cannot be shaken.' Zengzi held that true gentlemen must maintain unshakable moral firmness in all critical moments. He integrated inner cultivation (inner sage) with external achievement (outer king), arguing that only through sincere will and rectified mind can one govern the state and bring peace to the world.
process: 通过内省修养建立不可动摇的道德根基
将内在德性转化为外在治理能力
在重大危机和抉择面前保持道义定力
通过传承将个人修养扩展为制度化的教化体系

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '君子所乎民者，则民亦如是乎'——曾子强调统治者必须以民为本、以德化民。在《孝经》中，他主张以教化而非刑罚来治理国家，认为'先王见教之可以化民也'是最高明的治国之道。通过孝道教化，将家庭伦理推广为社会政治秩序的基础，实现'不刑而治'的理想境界。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'What the ruler does for the people, the people will likewise do' — Zengzi emphasized that rulers must be people-centered and govern through moral transformation. In the Classic of Filial Piety, he argued that 'the former kings saw that instruction can transform the people' as the wisest governance. Through filial piety education, family ethics are extended to social-political order, achieving the ideal of 'governing without punishment.'
process: 将道德教化置于刑罚之前作为首要治理手段
通过孝道建立社会伦理基础
以榜样示范引导民风转变
在教化中实现自愿的社会秩序

thinking_modes.definition_zh: '天之未丧斯文也，匡人其如予何'——曾子自觉承担孔子道统的传承责任。他将孔子的思想精髓概括为忠恕一贯，通过弟子传给了曾申、曾元、曾西，再通过子思（孔伋）传给孟子，形成了儒家道统谱系中最重要的传承链条。曾子不仅是孔子思想的忠实继承者，更是将其系统化为可传授的工夫论体系的关键人物。
thinking_modes.definition_en: 'If heaven does not wish to destroy this culture, what can the men of Kuang do to me?' — Zengzi consciously assumed responsibility for transmitting Confucius's cultural legacy. He summarized Confucius's core teaching as the unity of Zhong and Shu, passing it through disciples Zeng Shen, Zeng Yuan, Zeng Xi, then to Sicu (Kong Ji), and finally to Mencius — forming the most important transmission chain in the Confucian Dao-school lineage. Zengzi was not merely a faithful inheritor but the key figure who systematized Confucius's teachings into an teachable practice methodology.
process: 准确理解并概括核心思想精髓
建立可传承的教学体系和工夫论框架
通过弟子一代代传递道统血脉
在传承中保持核心精神的纯正性
modern_applications: 知识传承与教育体系设计
学术传统的延续与创新

steps_zh: 第一步：慎独自省——以'君子必慎其独也'为起点，培养独处时的道德自觉和自我监控能力
第二步：忠恕一贯——以'吾道一以贯之，忠恕而已矣'把握孔子思想核心，建立内外统一的伦理实践
第三步：三省吾身——通过'日三省吾身'的日常反思机制，持续检视忠信习三维度
第四步：修齐治平——以《大学》八目为完整实践路径，从格物致知到治国平天下
第五步：孝道本体——以《孝经》将孝从家庭伦理提升为一切德行的根本和教化起点
第六步：士人担当——以'士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远'确立知识分子的终极使命
第七步：临终大节——以'战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰'的态度贯穿生命全程
第八步：内圣外王——将内在修养与外在事功贯通，在重大关头保持不可动摇的道德定力
第九步：民本教化——以孝道教化为先，实现'不刑而治'的理想社会秩序
第十步：道统传承——自觉承担孔子文化使命，通过思孟学派将儒家道统系统化传递
steps_en: Step 1: Shen-Du Watchfulness — Start with 'the gentleman must be watchful over himself when alone', cultivating moral self-awareness in solitude
Step 2: Zhong-Shu Unity — Grasp Confucius's core teaching as 'loyalty and reciprocity', establishing unified inner-outer ethical practice
Step 3: Daily Self-Examination — Through 'examining myself three times daily', continuously check the three dimensions of faithfulness, trustworthiness, and practice
Step 4: Eight Steps — Use the Great Learning's eight steps as complete practical path, from investigating things to pacifying the world
Step 5: Filial Piety Ontology — Elevate filial piety from family ethics to the root and origin of all moral values through the Classic of Filial Piety
Step 6: Scholar Responsibility — Establish intellectuals' ultimate mission through 'a scholar cannot be without breadth of mind and vigorous endurance'
Step 7: Final Integrity — Maintain 'trembling and fearful' attitude throughout life's entire course
Step 8: Inner Sage Outer King — Integrate inner cultivation with external achievement, maintaining unshakable moral firmness in critical moments
Step 9: Populist Education — Prioritize filial piety instruction to achieve 'governing without punishment' ideal social order
Step 10: Dao-School Transmission — Consciously assume Confucius's cultural mission, systematically transmitting the Confucian Dao through the Sicu-Mencius lineage
expected_zh: 确立慎独自省为儒家工夫论的核心方法，影响宋明理学心性修养传统
创建《大学》八目实践体系，为后世提供完整的修己治人方法论
将孝道提升为本体论原则，奠定中国传统社会的核心价值基础
通过忠恕一贯概括孔子思想精髓，为理解儒家学说提供关键钥匙
建立士人担当精神传统，塑造中国知识分子的身份认同和精神品格
expected_en: Established Shen-Du (watchfulness when alone) as the core method of Confucian practice, influencing Song-Ming Neo-Confucian mind-nature cultivation tradition
Created the Great Learning's Eight Steps practical system, providing a complete self-cultivation and governance methodology for later generations
Elevated filial piety to an ontological principle, laying the core value foundation of traditional Chinese society
Summarized Confucius's teaching essence as Zhong-Shu unity, providing the key to understanding Confucian doctrine
Established the scholar-responsibility spirit tradition, shaping the identity and character of Chinese intellectuals
case_zh: 曾子从孔子受业，以孝道和慎独著称。在《论语》中记载：他'日三省吾身'，每日从忠、信、习三个维度反省自身；他将孔子'一以贯之'的思想概括为'忠恕而已矣'，成为理解孔子思想体系的关键；临终之际检查身体完好（'启予足，启予手'），以一生恪守'身体发肤受之父母'的孝道为最终验证；他提出'士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远'，将知识分子的道德担当提升到极致。其思想通过曾申传曾元、曾西，再经子思传给孟子，形成儒家道统谱系。《大学》提出的八目工夫论和《孝经》的孝道本体论，成为后世儒家最重要的两部经典。
case_en: Zengzi studied under Confucius, known for filial piety and Shen-Du. Recorded in the Analects: he 'examined himself three times daily' across faithfulness, trustworthiness, and practice; he summarized Confucius's 'one thread' as 'loyalty and reciprocity alone,' becoming the key to understanding Confucius's teaching; at his deathbed he examined his intact body ('open my feet, open my hands'), using a life devoted to 'body and hair received from parents' as his final verification; he stated 'a scholar cannot be without breadth of mind and vigorous endurance,' elevating intellectuals' moral responsibility to its utmost. His thought passed through Zeng Shen to Zeng Yuan and Zeng Xi, then via Sicu (Kong Ji) to Mencius, forming the Confucian Dao-school lineage. The Eight Steps of self-cultivation in the Great Learning and the filial piety ontology of the Classic of Filial Piety became the two most important Confucian classics for later generations.

figure_name_zh: 黄宗羲：天下主权·治法优先·学术史范式
era: 明末清初 / Late Ming-Early Qing (1610-1695 CE)
primary_domain: 哲学/政治思想/经世致用
school: 浙东学派/阳明心学/批判理学/经世致用

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 政治合法性理论/民本主义
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 天下（人民）是政治主体的根本，君主只是天下的客人和服务者。颠覆了'君权神授'的传统逻辑：不是天立君以治民，而是民本位、君末位。'原君'篇指出，君主最初的设立是为了天下人的利益，而非相反。若君主以天下利益为私，则君主身份本身即构成对政治秩序的破坏。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Tianxia (the people/world) is the fundamental political subject; the ruler is merely a guest and servant of Tianxia. This subverts the traditional 'divine right' logic: not heaven establishes the ruler to govern the people, but the people are primary and the ruler secondary. The 'Origin of the Ruler' chapter argues the ruler was initially established for the benefit of all under heaven, not the reverse. If the ruler treats Tianxia's interests as private property, the rulership itself constitutes a disruption of political order.
process_zh: 追溯政治权力的起源：确认权力源于天下公利而非天命授予
区分'公天下'与'私天下'：判断统治者的行为是服务天下还是谋取私利
确立天下（人民）为政治合法性的终极来源
以天下万民的福祉作为评判政治制度优劣的唯一标准
process_en: Trace the origin of political power: confirm it derives from public good rather than heavenly mandate
Distinguish 'public Tianxia' from 'private Tianxia': judge whether governance serves all or merely private interests
Establish Tianxia (the people) as the ultimate source of political legitimacy
Use the well-being of all under heaven as the sole criterion for evaluating political systems
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 有生之初，人各自私也，人各自利也；天下有公利而莫或兴之，有公害而莫或除之。有人者出，不以一己之利为利，而使天下受其利；不以一己之害为害，而使天下释其害。此其人之勤劳必千万于天下之人。夫以千万倍之勤劳，而己又不享其利，必非天下之人情所欲居也。故古之人君，盍去者也？
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: In the beginning of human existence, each person sought their own benefit. When public good arose but none cultivated it, and public harm existed but none removed it, a person emerged who did not treat his own benefit as benefit, but enabled Tianxia to enjoy it; who did not treat his own harm as harm, but freed Tianxia from it. His labor must have been a million times that of ordinary people. Yet he enjoyed no benefit himself—surely no one would naturally seek such a position. Therefore, why should the ancient ruler exist as such?
representative_cases_zh: 《原君》开篇论证君主起源——君主本是替天下人服务的劳苦角色，后世君主却将天下视为私产
对比三代以上'以天下为主'与三代以后'以君为主'的历史退化观

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 制度设计理论/治理方法论
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 优良制度（治法）优先于个人品德（治人）。与儒家传统'有治人无治法'相反，黄宗羲指出后世的'非法之法'（专制律令）才是真正的祸根，没有好的制度框架，再贤明的君主也无法实现善治。这是中国思想史上首次系统论证制度优先于个人的政治主张。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Good institutions (zhi fa) take priority over individual virtue (zhi ren). Contrary to the traditional Confucian claim 'there are governing men but no governing laws,' Huang Zongxi argued that the 'non-law laws' of later ages (despotic ordinances) are the true root of disaster. Without sound institutional frameworks, even the most virtuous ruler cannot achieve good governance. This is the first systematic argument in Chinese intellectual history for institutional priority over individual character.
process_zh: 识别当前制度是'三代以上之法'（公法）还是'一家之法'（私法/非法之法）
分析制度对个人行为的约束与激励结构
判断制度设计是否以天下公利而非一姓私利为出发点
优先改进制度框架而非依赖道德教化或个人修养
process_en: Identify whether current institutions are 'laws of the Three Dynasties' (public law) or 'laws of one family' (private law/non-law)
Analyze how institutional constraints and incentives shape individual behavior
Judge whether institutional design originates from public good rather than dynastic self-interest
Prioritize institutional reform over reliance on moral education or personal cultivation
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 岂天地之大，于兆人万姓之上，复加一人哉？秦汉以来，对于天下，固以天下为己任；今也以一姓之私，而名曰天下。非法之法，桎梏天下人之手足，岂有治法乎？有治法而后有治人。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Is it that beyond the great earth and the millions of common people, another person is imposed? Since Qin and Han, rulers have treated Tianxia as their own undertaking; now they treat one family's private interest as Tianxia. These are non-law laws, manacles on the hands and feet of all under heaven—where is there any governing law? Good law must come before good governance by individuals.
representative_cases_zh: 《原法》篇对比三代以上'天下之法'与秦汉以后'一家之法'的本质区别
指出'藏天下于筐箧'的专制制度将国家视为私产
modern_applications_en: Theoretical foundation for rule of law construction

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 公共领域理论/协商民主
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 学校不应仅是教育机构，更应是政治议政的场所。'必使治天下之具皆出于学校'，学校成为评判是非、议决政策的公共空间。太学祭酒（校长）地位等同宰相，皇帝亦需出席学校参与讨论。这是中国思想史上最接近近代议会制度的构想，将'公其非是于学校'作为制约君权、实现公共理性讨论的制度设计。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Schools should not merely be educational institutions but venues for political deliberation. 'All instruments for governing Tianxia must originate from schools.' Schools become public spaces for judging right and wrong and deliberating policy. The Grand Learning's director holds status equivalent to the prime minister, and even the emperor must attend school sessions to participate in discussion. This is the closest conception to a modern parliamentary system in Chinese intellectual history, designing 'public judgment of right and wrong in schools' as an institutional mechanism to check imperial power and realize public rational deliberation.
process_zh: 建立独立于行政体系的学校/学术机构网络
赋予学校评判政治是非的法定权力
使学术领袖（祭酒）具有与行政首脑平等的政治地位
通过学校公开讨论形成公共舆论，制约君主决策
process_en: Establish independent school/academic institution networks separate from the administrative system
Grant schools legal authority to judge political right and wrong
Give academic leaders (director) political status equal to the head of government
Form public opinion through open school deliberations to check imperial decision-making
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 学校，所以养士也。然古之圣王，其意不仅此也，必使治天下之具皆出于学校，而后设学校之意始备。……是故政教合一如学校，而学校之议不可以不出于天下。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Schools exist to nurture scholars. But the ancient sage kings' purpose was not limited to this alone—they ensured all instruments for governing Tianxia originated from schools, and only then was the purpose of establishing schools fully realized. ... Therefore when governance and education are integrated as in schools, school deliberations must emerge from the whole world.
representative_cases_zh: 《学校》篇提出太学祭酒'批红'权，皇帝决策须在学校讨论后方可施行
地方学校定期评议地方政务，形成自下而上的舆论监督机制
modern_applications_zh: 学术界与政治界互动机制
独立媒体与公共舆论功能
modern_applications_en: Independent media and public opinion functions

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 反对程朱理学'理在气先'的二元论，主张'理即是气之理'，理不能离气而独存。宇宙本原是一气流行，理只是气的运行规律而非独立实体。'盈天地皆心也，变化不测，不能不万殊'，心与气、理与气统一于物质性的气本原。这一立场奠定了明清之际唯物主义哲学的转向。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Opposing Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucian dualism of 'li prior to qi,' arguing 'li is simply the li of qi'; li cannot exist independently apart from qi. The universe's primordial substance is a single qi in flux, and li is merely qi's operational pattern, not an independent entity. 'The whole cosmos is heart-mind, changeful and unpredictable, necessarily diverse'—heart and qi, li and qi are unified in the material primacy of qi. This stance founded the early modern materialist philosophical turn in China.
process_zh: 识别将抽象概念（理/道/太极）实体化的倾向
追溯一切现象的物质基础（气）
确认规律（理）依赖于载体（气）而存在
在气本论基础上重建对世界的理解
process_en: Identify tendencies to reify abstract concepts (li/Dao/taiji) into entities
Trace all phenomena back to their material basis (qi)
Confirm that patterns (li) depend on carriers (qi) for existence
Rebuild understanding of the world on qi-monism foundations
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 天地间只有一气循环，周流不息，理即在气中，非气外别有理也。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Between heaven and earth there is only qi cycling endlessly, flowing through all; li exists within qi, there is no separate li outside qi.
representative_cases_zh: 批判朱熹'理先气后'说，指出'若谓理在气先，则是理别为一物矣'
以天文学和历算学研究佐证理气统一观

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 真理（一本）通过无数个体化路径（万殊）显现，学术发展不应强求统一标准。编纂《明儒学案》时，黄宗羲主张'有一偏之见，有相反之论，学者于其不同处正宜着眼理会'，反对'以水济水'的同质化。各学派宗旨不同但皆求道，这正是'一本而万殊'的学术生态观。这一方法论突破了'独尊一途'的学术专制传统。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Truth (one essence) manifests through countless individualized paths (many manifestations); scholarship should not demand uniform standards. In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' Huang advocated 'each has partial views and opposing arguments; scholars should pay attention to their differences,' opposing homogenization 'pouring water into water.' Different schools pursue different approaches but all seek the Dao—this is the academic ecology of 'one essence, many manifestations.' This methodology broke through the tradition of 'exclusive devotion to one path' in scholarship.
process_zh: 承认学术传统的多元性：不同学派各有其合理内核
不以单一标准裁剪异见，保留'一偏之见'与'相反之论'
在各家不同处着力理会，从中萃取真理性认识
在多元争鸣中把握统一的学术精神（一本）
process_en: Acknowledge academic tradition's plurality: different schools each contain valid kernels
Do not cut dissenting views to a single standard; preserve 'partial views' and 'opposing arguments'
Focus on differences among schools to extract truthful insights
Grasp the unifying academic spirit (one essence) amid pluralistic debate
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 学问之道，以各人自用得着者为真。凡倚门傍户、依样葫芦者，非流俗之士，则经生之业也。此编所列，有一偏之见，有相反之论，学者于其不同处正宜着眼理会，所谓一本而万殊也。以水济水，岂是学问！
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: The way of learning is that which each person finds genuinely useful to themselves is true. Those who lean on doors and copy others are either vulgar persons or mere bookworms. What this compilation lists includes partial views and opposing arguments; scholars should focus on their differences—this is what is meant by 'one essence, many manifestations.' Pouring water into water—how can that be scholarship!
representative_cases_zh: 《明儒学案》以王学为主流但不废朱学、陆学诸派，各述宗旨不相贬损
批评孙奇逢《理学宗传》'杂收不复甄别'，主张从全集'纂要钩玄'

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 学问的根本目的在于'经世应务'——解决现实社会问题，而非空谈心性。'学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务'，将经学研究与历史考证结合，以史证经、以经驭史，最终服务于治国平天下的实践目标。这是对明代王学末流空疏学风的直接批判。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The fundamental purpose of learning is 'practical statecraft'—solving real social problems—not empty contemplation of nature and mind. 'Learning must originate from classical studies to avoid empty vacuity, and must be verified through historical records to be sufficient for practical affairs.' Integrating classical research with historical verification, using history to verify classics and classics to guide history, ultimately serving the practical goal of governing and pacifying the world. This is a direct critique of the vacuous scholarship of late Ming Wang school.
process_zh: 确立学问的最终目的是解决现实问题（应务）
以经学为根基确保理论的正当性来源
以史学为验证工具确保理论的经验基础
将知识生产与社会实践紧密结合
process_en: Establish that learning's ultimate purpose is solving real-world problems
Use classical studies as foundation to ensure theoretical legitimacy
Use historical verification as verification tool to ensure empirical grounding
Tightly integrate knowledge production with social practice
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 学必原本于经术而后不为蹈虚，必证明于史籍而后足以应务。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Learning must originate from classical studies to avoid empty vacuity, and must be verified through historical records to be sufficient for practical affairs.
representative_cases_zh: 编撰《明文海》四十余年，保存一代文献以为经世之资
著《明夷待访录》专为解决当时政治制度弊病而作

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以严密的考证方法辨别史料真伪，反对盲从权威和片面记载。'国史取详年月，野史取当是非，家史备官爵世系'，根据不同史料类型确定取舍标准。用天文学推算验证《春秋》日食记录，以历法知识判定古文《尚书》真伪，体现了'实事求是'的实证精神。重视一手材料，反对'谀墓单辞'。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using rigorous verification methods to distinguish authentic from spurious sources, opposing blind deference to authority and selective records. 'Official histories take detailed chronology, unofficial histories take proper judgment of right and wrong, family histories prepare genealogical records'—determining selection criteria by source type. Using astronomical calculations to verify Spring and Autumn Annals eclipse records, applying calendrical knowledge to determine the authenticity of the Old Text Shangshu, embodying the 'seeking truth from facts' empirical spirit. Valuing primary sources, opposing 'flattering epitaphs.'
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《明儒学案》《春秋日食历》《历代甲子考》
process_zh: 区分史料类型：国史、野史、家史各有其功能与局限
对同一事件的不同记载进行交叉比对
运用专门知识（如天文学、历法学）验证历史记录的准确性
汰除传闻之误和爱憎之偏，去伪存真
process_en: Distinguish source types: official, unofficial, and family histories each have functions and limitations
Cross-compare different accounts of the same event
Apply specialized knowledge (astronomy, calendrics) to verify historical record accuracy
Eliminate rumor errors and bias, preserving truth while discarding falsehood
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 桑海之交，纪事之书杂出，或传闻之误，或爱憎之口，多非事实。以余所见，唯《传信录》、《所知录》、《劫灰录》，庶几与邓光荐之《填海录》可考信不诬。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: At the transition of dynastic change, record-keeping books emerge in a mixed manner—some from hearsay errors, some from personal favoritism or hostility. Based on my observations, only 'Chuanxin Lu,' 'Suozhi Lu,' and 'Jiehui Lu,' perhaps along with Deng Guangjian's 'Tianhai Lu,' are reliable and not false.
representative_cases_zh: 用西汉三统历和唐代授时历推算春秋日食，验证《春秋》记载的可信度
以历法知识参与阎若璩《尚书古文疏证》的辨伪工作

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 税制改革往往导致税负反弹的规律性现象：每次简化税制、合并税种的改革，短期内确实减轻了农民负担，但随后新增名目繁多的附加税又会将负担推到比改革前更高的水平。'积累莫返之害'揭示了制度性腐败的内在逻辑——统治者在税制改革中并非真正让利，而是通过'并税式改革'将隐性剥削合法化后，再叠加新的盘剥。这一规律超越了时代，适用于分析任何制度变革中的利益分配问题。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The regular pattern whereby tax reform leads to fiscal burden rebound: each simplification and consolidation reform briefly reduces peasant burdens, but new additional taxes soon drive burdens higher than before reform. 'Accumulated harm that cannot be reversed' reveals the internal logic of institutional corruption—rulers do not genuinely concede benefits in tax reform, but rather legitimize hidden exploitation through 'tax-consolidation reform,' then layer new exactions upon it. This pattern transcends its era and applies to analyzing benefit distribution in any institutional change.
process_zh: 识别税制改革的表层承诺（简并税种、减轻负担）与深层动机
追踪改革前后实际负担的变化轨迹
识别改革中隐藏的'附加'机制：以并税名义取消旧税，再以新名目恢复并加码
预判改革的长期效应，防止'积累莫返'的陷阱
process_en: Identify the surface promises (tax consolidation, burden reduction) versus deep motives of reform
Track actual burden changes before and after reform
Identify hidden 'addition' mechanisms: abolishing old taxes in the name of consolidation, then restoring them with new labels and higher rates
Predict long-term reform effects to avoid the 'irreversible accumulation' trap
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 以一姓之规，而欲传之永久，莫如并税。……然并税之后，所加又多于并税之前矣。此积累莫返之害也。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Using one family's regulations hoping to transmit them perpetually—nothing better than tax consolidation. ...Yet after consolidation, what is added exceeds what preceded it. This is the harm of accumulated irreversibility.
representative_cases_zh: 唐代两税法、明代一条鞭法、清代摊丁入亩，每次改革后农民负担均反弹超越改革前
清代秦晖总结命名'黄宗羲定律'，成为分析中国税制史的经典工具

thinking_modes.domain_zh: 文化认同理论/民族政治学
thinking_modes.domain_en: Cultural Identity Theory / Ethnic Political Science
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以文化（华夏文明）而非种族血统作为区分'华夏'与'夷狄'的标准。'自三代以后，乱天下者无如夷狄矣'，但黄宗羲的'夷夏之辨'并非单纯的种族主义，而是强调文明的先进性与落后性。当夷狄具备文明秩序时，可以接受其统治；当华夏丧失文明时，则等于夷狄。这一文化主义取向使其区别于狭隘的民族主义。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Using culture (Chinese civilization) rather than racial lineage as the criterion for distinguishing 'Xia' from 'Yi.' 'Since the Three Dynasties, none has devastated Tianxia more than the Yi and Di,' but Huang's 'Yi-Xia distinction' is not mere racism—it emphasizes the advancement and backwardness of civilization. When the Yi possess civilized order, their rule may be accepted; when Xia loses civilization, it becomes equivalent to Yi. This culturalist orientation distinguishes him from narrow nationalism.
process_zh: 以文化文明程度而非血统种族判断族群归属
在文化沦丧时，本族等于夷狄；在文化进步时，夷狄可入华夏
坚守文化正统，但不陷入种族主义陷阱
将文化传承视为高于政权更替的更高价值
process_en: Judge ethnic belonging by cultural-civilizational level rather than bloodline or race
When culture is lost, one's own people equal Yi; when culture advances, Yi can enter Xia
Uphold cultural orthodoxy without falling into racist traps
Treat cultural transmission as a higher value than regime change
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 自三代以后，乱天下者无如夷狄矣！
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Since the Three Dynasties, none has devastated Tianxia more than the Yi and Di!
representative_cases_zh: 明亡后终身守节不仕清朝，以'夷夏之辨'为抵抗清廷统治的精神支柱
但同时也承认西方天文学的精密，主张'会通中西之学'

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 在尊重各家'一偏之见'的基础上，通过'会众以合一'的归纳方法，从多元学术传统中萃取共同精神。与'一本万殊法'互为表里：一本万殊是分析视角（从共性见差异），会众合一是归纳视角（从差异见共性）。编《明儒学案》时，'皆从全集纂要钩玄'——从每位学者的全集中提炼其宗旨，既不抹杀个性，又揭示共性，实现了'万殊归一本'的学术综合。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Respecting each school's 'partial views,' through the inductive method of 'synthesizing the many into one,' extracting shared spirit from diverse academic traditions. Complementary to the 'One Essence Many Manifestations' method: the latter is analytical (seeing difference from commonality), this one is inductive (seeing commonality from difference). In compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' 'from each scholar's complete works, extract the essential threads'—distilling each thinker's core tenets without erasing individuality, yet revealing commonality, achieving the synthesis of 'many manifestations returning to one essence.'
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《明儒学案·发凡》《万充宗墓志铭》
process_zh: 充分收集各学派/各作者的原始文本
从每家全集中提炼核心宗旨（钩玄），不随意删改
在保持各家差异的前提下，寻找贯通的深层结构
将多元认识综合为更高层次的统一理解
process_en: Thoroughly collect original texts from all schools/authors
Extract core tenets from each complete work, without arbitrary editing
While preserving differences among schools, find the connecting deep structure
Synthesize pluralistic understanding into a higher-level unified comprehension
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 士生千载之下，不能会众以合一，由谷而之川，川以达于海，犹可谓之穷经乎？
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: A scholar born a thousand years later, unable to synthesize the many into one—from valley to river, from river to sea—can we still call this mastering the classics?
representative_cases_zh: 《明儒学案》六十二卷，涵盖明代近三百年学术流派，每案各自宗旨鲜明，整体又构成统一脉络
批评孙奇逢《理学宗传》'杂收不复甄别'，主张从全集'纂要钩玄'

summary_zh: 黄宗羲（明末清初，1610-1695），浙东学派/阳明心学代表人物，提出十大核心思维模式（M301-M310）。
summary_en: Huang Zongxi (Late Ming-Early Qing, 1610-1695), Zhejiang East school representative, proposed 10 core thinking modes (M301-M310).

name_zh: 太虚即气法
definition_zh: 以太虚为气的本然状态，认为宇宙根本实体是气而非空无，万物由气凝聚而成，气散则复归太虚。此法通过确立气的本体地位，构建完整的物质宇宙论，反对佛道的虚无主义。
definition_en: Taking Tai Xu (Great Emptiness) as the original state of qi, this method holds that the fundamental substance of the universe is qi rather than nothingness. All phenomena arise from the condensation of qi, and when qi disperses, it returns to Tai Xu. This method establishes qi as the ontological foundation to construct a complete materialist cosmology, opposing Buddhist and Daoist nihilism.
process_steps: 确立气的本体地位，否定'有生于无'
理解太虚为气的本然状态而非绝对虚空
认识万物为气的凝聚形态
把握气的聚散变化为宇宙运行的根本规律

name_zh: 仇必和而解法
definition_zh: 认为矛盾对立是宇宙的根本现象（'有象斯有对'），但最终必然走向和解统一（'仇必和而解'）。此法超越了简单的对立思维，主张在矛盾冲突中寻求动态平衡与和谐统一。
definition_en: This method holds that contradictory opposition is a fundamental phenomenon of the universe ('where there is form, there is opposition'), but ultimately harmony and unity will prevail ('enmity must resolve in harmony'). It transcends simple dualistic thinking, advocating for dynamic balance and harmonious unity amid contradictory conflicts.
process_steps: 识别矛盾对立面（'有象斯有对'）
理解对立面的相互依存关系（'对必反其为'）
认识矛盾冲突的必然性（'有反斯有仇'）
寻求并最终实现和解统一（'仇必和而解'）
applications: 矛盾调和理论与冲突解决
协商民主与可持续发展

name_zh: 民胞物与法
definition_zh: 将天地视为父母、所有人视为同胞、万物视为伴侣的普遍关怀方法。此法超越了血缘和地缘的限制，构建了以宇宙为家庭的全人类共同体伦理观。
definition_en: Treating Heaven and Earth as parents, all people as siblings, and all things as companions, this method constructs a universal care framework that transcends blood and geographic limitations, forming an ethics of global community with the universe as a family.
process_steps: 以天地为父母建立宇宙亲情观
将所有人视为同胞兄弟
将万物视为伴侣朋友
在实践中践行普遍的关爱与责任
applications: 可持续发展与企业社会责任

name_zh: 大心体物法
name_en: Expanding Heart to Encompass All Things Method
definition_zh: 大其心则能体天下之物，物有未体，则心为有外。世人之心，止于闻见之狭。圣人尽性，不以见闻梏其心。其视天下无一物非我。此法强调超越感官局限，以直觉体认达到与万物一体的境界。
definition_en: Expand the mind greatly and you can embody all things in the world. If any thing remains unembodyed, the mind has boundaries. Ordinary people's minds are confined to sensory experience. The sage exhausts nature without being imprisoned by sensory knowledge. This method emphasizes transcending sensory limitations to achieve the state of unity with all things through intuitive realization.
process_steps: 识别感官经验的局限性
超越见闻之知，追求德性之知
扩大心量，将万物纳入整体体认
以天地之心为心，达到万物一体之境
applications: 整体性思考与格局提升

name_zh: 德性之知法
definition_zh: 将知识分为见闻之知与德性之知两类，认为真正的道德智慧来源于内在德性的自觉，而非外在感官经验。此法强调道德认知的先验性与超越性。
definition_en: Dividing knowledge into sensory knowledge and moral knowledge, this method holds that true moral wisdom stems from inner moral consciousness rather than external sensory experience. It emphasizes the a priori and transcendent nature of moral cognition.
process_steps: 区分见闻之知与德性之知
认识见闻之知的局限（'不萌于见闻'）
通过'德盛仁熟'体认德性之知
以德性之知指导道德实践

name_zh: 变化气质法
definition_zh: 通过道德修养和实践改变先天的气质之性，恢复纯粹的天地之性。此法是张载伦理学的核心方法，强调后天修养对于人性完善的重要性。
definition_en: Through moral cultivation and practice, transforming one's physical nature to restore the pure heavenly nature. This is the core method of Zhang Zai's ethics, emphasizing the importance of 后天 cultivation for human perfection.
process_steps: 认识自身的禀赋限制（气质之偏）
通过学习知识、实践礼仪来变化气质
持之以恒，日积月累地修养
最终回归本然的天地之性

name_zh: 一物两体法
definition_zh: 认为任何事物都包含阴阳两个对立面，两体合一构成事物的本质。此法是张载辩证思维的核心，强调对立统一是宇宙运行的根本规律。
definition_en: Holding that any thing contains yin and yang as two opposing aspects, whose unity constitutes the essence of the thing. This is the core of Zhang Zai's dialectical thinking, emphasizing that the unity of opposites is the fundamental law of cosmic operation.
process_steps: 认识事物的双重属性（'一物两体'）
理解阴阳的对立统一关系
把握'两不立则一不可见'的辩证关系
运用一物两体思维分析和解决问题

name_zh: 经世致用法
definition_zh: 将哲学思考转化为经世济民的实际政策，主张通过恢复三代之法（井田、封建、礼乐）来解决当时的社会问题。此法体现了张载思想强烈的现实关怀与实践取向。
definition_en: Transforming philosophical reflection into practical governance for the benefit of the people, advocating the restoration of the Three Dynasties' methods (well-field system, feudal enfeoffment, ritual and music) to address contemporary social problems.
process_steps: 诊断社会问题的根源（贫富不均等）
寻求古代理想制度的参照
设计具体的政策方案（井田、礼俗）
在实践中推行验证

name_zh: 学贵心悟法
definition_zh: 强调学习过程中心的体悟比机械记忆更重要，主张'守旧无功'、'学贵心悟'。此法是张载方法论的核心，体现了对主体性思维的重视。
definition_en: Emphasizing that heart-intuition in learning is more important than mechanical memorization, advocating 'rejecting the old is without merit' and 'learning values heart-intuition'. This is the core of Zhang Zai's methodology, reflecting the importance of subjective thinking.
process_steps: 以疑问为学习的起点
通过心的体悟来理解义理
质疑守旧观念，追求创新
在理解基础上形成个人洞见

name_zh: 知礼成性法
definition_zh: 通过学习和践行礼仪规范来成就和完善人的本性，将外在的礼内化为内在的德性。此法是张载道德实践的核心路径。
definition_en: Through learning and practicing ritual norms to achieve and perfect human nature, internalizing external li (ritual propriety) as internal virtue. This is the core path of Zhang Zai's moral practice.
process_steps: 学习礼的规范与意义
在实践中践行礼的要求
将礼内化为自身的德性
达到'从心所欲不逾矩'的境界
